560: Rabba, vealin begavveh. veinnun orchin mitpattechin lechol ivar, ulechol sitre alma.

Vehay noam, hu neimu denafik mealma deate, (nusach acher umealma deate naharin kol butzinin) venahir lechol butzinin, umitparshin (nusach acher nehorin) lechol ivar, vehahu tivu, unehora dealma deate, deyankin avahan, ikre noam. davar acher, alma deate, ikre noam. vechad ittear alma deate, kol tivu, vechol chedu, vechol nehorin, vechol cheru dealma ittear. uvegine kach, ikre noam.

Veal da tanenan, chayyayvin degehinnam, beshaata deal shabbeta, kullehu nayychin, veit lehu (sefer acher cheru) chedu, venayycha beshabbata. kevan denafik shabbeta, it lan leatara chedu illaa alana, denishteziv mehahu onsha dechayyavay, deitdanu mehahi shaata ulehala. veit lan leatara velema, (Tehillim 90:17) vihi noam Adonai elohenu alenu. da hu noam illaa, (cheru) chedu decholla. veal da, deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom.

Man netivoteha. illen innun netivot ushevilin, denafke milleella, vechullehu nakit lon berit yechiday, deihu ikre shalom, shelama deveta, veail lon leyamma rabba, kad ihu betukepeh. ucheden yahiv leh shelam. hada hu dichtiv vechol netivoteha shalom. (ad kan) atu ribbi yesa 206 chizkiyya, venashku leh, amru uma kol hane millin illain temirin gabbach, vela yadana. azlu. kad matu chad be chakal, chamu beire deve chakal metin, amru vadday dever diviyiri it baatar da.
Amar hahu yudai, ha deamrittu dekudesha berich hu katal bemitzrayim, kol innun ane, kol innun beire. telat motane havo bivire. chad, dever. vechad, innun dekatil barad. vechad, innun buchere divire.

Uma hava motana dilhon. ella, ha, ketiv bekadmita, (Shemot 9:3) hinne yad Adonai hoya bemiknecha asher bassade, amay bechullehu la ketiv yad Adonai. ella, hacha (nusach acher lo ketiv yad elohim ella yad Adonai) (sefer acher el yad Adonai) ihu yada bachamishsha etzbean. deha bekadmita ketiv, etzba elohim hi. vehacha kullehu chamesh etzbean, vechol etzbea veetzbea, katal zina chada. vachamishsha zinin havo, dichtiv, bassusim, bachamorim, baggemallim, babbakar, uvatztzon. ha chamishsha zinin, lachamishsha etzbean, deikrun yad. begine kach, hinne yad Adonai hoya vegomer dever kaved meod. dahavo metim miggarmayyhu, veishtechachu metim.

Batar dela ahadru mitzrae, innun atvavn mammash, ahadru vekatlu kol innun deishtaaru. vedever, ahdar barad. ma ben hay lehay. ella da benichuta, veda bitkifu derugeza. uteren illen, havo baatar chad, bechamesh etzbean.

Ta chaze, dever atvavn dahavo benichuta, motana benayycha, dahavo metin miggarmayyhu. barad, deithaddaru atvavn bitkof rugeza, vekatal kolla. yatvu behahu chakal, chamu ane deatyayn laatar chad, umetin tamman, kam hahu yudai legabbe hahu atar, vechama teren katfire, demalyayn akusetra.

Patach veamar, ketiv (Bereshit 12:2) veeescha legoy gadol vaavarechcha vaagaddela shemecha vehye beracha, hay milla deribbi elazar, deamar, veeescha legoy gadol, lokovel lech lecha. vaavarechcha, lokovel meartzecha. vaagaddela shemecha, lokovel umimmoladtecha. vehye beracha, lokovel umibbet avicha. veda lokovel da.

Rabbi shimon amar, raza dechachmeta hacha. veeescha legoy gadol, lokovel setar yemina. vaavarechcha, lokovel setar semala. vaagaddela shemecha, lokovel setar emtzaita. vehye beracha, lokovel setar ara deyisrael. vecholla raza dirticha kaddisha.

Ta chaze, beitaruta diltatta, ittear leella. vead la yittear letatta, la yittear leella, leashraa aleh. ma ketiv beavraham, (Bereshit 11:31) vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim. vayyetzu ittam, vayyetzu itto mibbae leh. deha ketiv vayyikkach terach et avram beno (veet lot ben haran) vegomer. mahu vayyetzu ittam. ella, terach velot nafku im avraham vesara, dechevan deishteziv avraham min nura, ithaddar terach lemebad reuteh. uvegin
561: Kach, vayyetzu ittam. kevan deinnun itaru bekadmita, amar leh kudesha berich hu lech lecha.

Ribbi shimon amar, lech lecha. letikkunacha legarmach. meartzecha, mehahu sitra deyishshuva deat takil, deityelidat beh. umimmoladtecha, mehahu tolda dilach. umibbet avicha, deat ashgach besharasha dilhon. el haaretz asher arekka, taman itgele lach, ma deat bae, hahu chela dimmana alla, deihu amik vesatim. miyyad, vayyelech avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai. vaanan ka baenan lemehach mehacha leminda raza dechachmeta (chaser).

Ribbi yose veribbi chiyyay havo azle beorcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, amay at shatik, ha orcha la ittekan, ella bemille deorayyta. itnegid ribbi chiyyay, uvacha, patach veamar, (Bereshit 11:30) vattehi saray akara en lah valad vavy al da, vavy al hahu zimna deolidat hagar leyishmael.

(Patach rabbi abba veamar 0 ki az ahepavech el ammim safa berura likro kullam beshem Adonai leavdo shechem echad. uchetiv 1 vehaya Adonai lemelech vegomer beyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad) amar leh ribbi yose, amay. veha olidat levatar, vahava lah bera giza kaddisha. amar leh, at chame, vaana chamena, vehachi shemana mippumoy derabbi shimon milla, uvachena (sefer acher ameraz leh may hi amar leh vavy vechulei) vavy al hahu zimna, divgin desara itakkevat, ketiv, (Bereshit 16:5) vattomer saray el avram vegomer bo na el shifchati vegomer. veal da, kayyeyma shaata lehagar, lemerat lesara gevirtah, vahava lah bera meavraham.

Veavraham amar, (Bereshit 17:18) lu yishmael yichye lefanecha, veaf al gav dekudesha berich hu hava mevasser leh al yitzchak, itdevak avraham beyishmael, ad dekudesha berich hu ativ leh, (Bereshit 17:20) uleyishmael shematicha vegomer. levatar itgezar, veal bekayyeyma kaddisha, ad la yippuk yitzchak lealma.

Veta chaze, arba mea shenin, kayyeyma hahu memana divni yishmael, uvaa kame kudesha berich hu, amar leh, man deitgezar it leh chulaka bishmach. amar leh in. amar leh veha yishmael deitgezar, (velo od ella deitgezar bar telesar shenin) amay let leh chulaka bach kemo yitzchak. amar leh, da itgezar kedka yeot uchetikkunoy, veda lav hachi. velo od, ella deillen mitdabbekin bi kedka yeot, litmanya yomin veillen rechikin minni ad kamma yamim. amar leh, veim kol da, kevan deitgezar la yehe leh agar tav begineh.

Vavy al hahu zimna, deityelid yishmael bealma, veitgezar. ma aved kudesha berich hu, archik lehu livne yishmael, middevekuta dilella, veyahav lehu chulaka letatta beara kaddisha, begin hahu geziru dibbehon.

Uzeminin bene yishmael, lemishlat beara kaddisha, kad ihi rekanya mikkolla, zimna saggi, kema digziru dilhon berekanyya belo shelimu. veinnun yeakkevun lehon livni yisrael leatava leduchetayyhu, ad deishtelim hahu zechuta divne yishmael.

Uzeminin bene yishmael, leatara keravin takkifin bealma, uleitkannesha beni edom alayyhu, veyitarun kerava behu, chad al yamma, vechad al yabbeshta vechad samuch lirushelem, veyishletun illen beillen, veara kaddisha la yitmesar livni edom.

Behahu zimna, yittear amma chad missayyfe alma, al romi chayyayva, veyiggach bah kerava telat yarchin, veyitkanneshun tamman amamyya, veyippelun bidayyhu, ad deyitkanneshun kol beni edom alla, mikkol sayyfe alma. ucheden yittear kudesha berich hu alayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:6) ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra vegomer. ulevatar da ma ketiv, leechoz bechanfot haaretz vegomer vishetze livne yishmael minah, veyitbar kol chelin dilella vela yishtear chela leella al amma dealma, ella chela deyisrael bilchodoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 121:5) Adonai tzillecha al yad yeminecha.

Begin dishma kaddisha bimina, veorayyta bimina, veal da bimina talya kolla vetanenan, devae lezakfa yemina al semala, kema deukemuha. dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. uvezimna deate, (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni. uvehahu zimna ketiv, (Tzefanya 3:9) ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai leavdo shechem echad. uchetiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen:
562: (Shemot 10:1) vayyomer Adonai el moshe bo el paro ki ani hichbadti et libbo vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach vamar, (tehillim 89) ashre haam yode terua Adonai beor panycha yehallechun. kamma itzterichu bene nasha, lemehach bearche dekudesha berich hu, ulemitar pikkude orayyta, begin deyizkun bah lealma deate, uleshezava lon mikkol kitrugin dilella vetatta. begin, deha kema deishtechachu mekatregin bealma letatta, hachi name ishtechachu mekatregin leella dekayyme alayyhu divne nasha.

Innun deavdin pikkude orayyta, veazle beorach meshar, bidchala demarehon, kamma innun sannegorin dekayymin alayyhu leella, kema deat amar (Iyov 33:23) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef vegomer. uchetiv vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer. begin kach, zakkaa ihu man denatir pikkude orayyta.

Amar leh ribbi chiyyay, i hachi, amay itzterich hacha malach delehevi sannegora aleh devar nash veha ketiv (Mishlei 3:26) ki Adonai yihye bechislecha vshamar raglecha millached, uchetiv (Tehillim 121:7) Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra. deha chame kudesha berich hu, kol ma devar nash avid bealma, hen tav hen bish. vechen hu omer, (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, kolla hachi hu vadday. aval ha ketiv, (Iyov 2:Adonai) vega el atzmo veel besaro. uchetiv, (Iyov 2:Adonai) vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam. leachazaa deha reshu itmesar lesitra achara lekatrega, (ureshu itmesar) al millin dealma, (leman dela itzterich) uleitmassera bidoy. vechol illen archin temirin kame kudesha berich hu, velet ant keday lemehach avatrayyhu, begin deinnun nimmusin dekudesha berich hu, uvene nasha lav innun rashshain ledakdeka avatrayyhu, bar innun zakkae keshot deyadin raze orayyta, veazlin bearcha dechachmeta leminda innun millin setimin deorayyta.

Ribbi elazar patach, (Iyov 1:6) vayhi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai vayyavo gam hassatan betocham. vayhi hayyom: da (44 1) rosh hashshana, dekudesha berich hu kaim lemedan alma. kegavvna da, (Melachim 2 4:11) vayhi hayyom vayyavo shamma. hahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava.

Vayyavou bene haelohim, illen ravrevin memanan shelichan bealma, leashgecha beovadin divni nasha. lehityatztzev al Adonai: kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 22:19) vechol tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav mimino umissemolo. aval lehityatztzev al Adonai behay kera ashkachna rechimuta dekudesha berich hu alayyhu deyisrael. begin, dehane shelichan, deinnun memanan leashgacha al ovadin divne nasha, azlin veshatin venatlin innun ovadin kullehu, uveyoma dekae dina lemekam, lemedan alma, itavidu kategorin lemekam alayyhu divne nasha. veta chaze, mikkol ammin dealma, la kayymin leashgacha beovadehon, bar beyisrael bilchodayyhu, begin deillen benin lekudesha berich hu.

Vechad la ishtechachu ovadin deyisrael kedka yeot, kivyachol innun memanan shelichan, kad baan lekayyeyma al innun ovadin deyisrael, al Adonai vadday kayymin, deha kad yisrael avdin ovadin dela kashran, kivyachol mattishin chela dekudesha berich hu. vechad avdin ovadin dechashran, yahavin tukepa vechela lekudesha berich hu. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 68:35) tenu oz lelohim. bema. beovadin dechashran. veal da, behahu yoma, kullehu ravrevan memanan itkanashu al Adonai. al Adonai vadday, deha kevan deal yisrael itkanashu, aleh itkanashu.
Vayyavo gam hassatan betocham, gam, leasgaa alayyhu, dechullehu atyayn lemeheve kategorin alayyhu deyisrael,
563: Veda ittosaf alayyhu, begin deihu dayltora ravreva mikkullehu, kategora mikkullehu, kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, dechullehu atyayn lekatrega. miyyad vayyomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo. vechi lo hava yada kudesha berich hu, mean hava ate. ella leayytaa ovada liruteh.

Vayyomer Adonai el hassatan vegomer vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar mishshut baaretz. mikkan olifna, deyishshuva deara itmesar lesitrin acharanin, bar ara deyisrael bilchodaha. kevan deamar mishshut baaretz, ashgach kudesha berich hu, devae lemeheve daltora alayyhu deyisrael. miyyad, (Iyov 1:8) vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz.

Chama shaata lemehav leh chulaka, bema (58 64 amud alef) deyitasak, veyitperash minnayyhu deyisrael, veha ukemuha, leraya devaa lemebar aneh bechad nahara vechulei, miyyad itassak beh hahu satan, velo kitreg alayyhu deyisrael.
Vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim. lav tavavha leavda demareh avid leh kol reuteh, dihe dachil leh, ade ashgachutach mineh, vetechome i dachil lach veim lav.

Ta chaze, beshaata deaku, kad ityeyhiv chulaka chada lehay setar leitasseka beh, itperish levatar mikkolla. kegavvna da sair berosh chodesh. sair beyoma dechippure. begin deitassak beh, veshavik lehu leyisrael bemalchehon, vehacha, mata zimna lemetal chulaka da, mikkol zara deavraham, besitra achara. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 22:20) hinne yalda milka gam hi vegomer et utz bechoro vegomer.

Veta chaze, beshaata deamar mishshut baaretz, baa minneh, lemebad dina beyisrael, deha dina hava leh al avraham, lemitba mekkudesha berich hu. begin, dela itavid dina beyitzchak, kad itkeriv al gabbe madbecha, deha la hava leh leachlefa karbena deazmin al madbecha, boochara, (vechen bechol sitra dilleh) kema deat amar, (Vayikra 27) lo yachalifennu. vehacha kaim yitzchak al gabbe madbecha, vela ishtelim minneh karbena, vela itavid beh dina, uvaa da meim kudesha berich hu, kema devaa dinih deyosef lechamma darin. vechol ma devaa, beorach dina baa.

Umehahu zimna deishteziv yitzchak, veitchallaf karbaneh, zammin leh kudesha berich hu, lehahu mekatrega, hay lechulakeh, kema deat amer hinne yalda milka gam hi vegomer et utz bechoro. vehacha, mata lemetal chulakeh aleh, mikkol zareh deavraham, vela yikrav besitra achara.

Vecholla bedina ata. (sefer acher legabbeh) kema deihu dan, hachi ittedan. begin deiyyov mikkerive eta defaro hava, vechad kam paro alayyhu deyisrael, baa lekatla lon. amar leh la, ella tol mamonehon ushelot al gufehon, befulechana kashya, vela tiktol lon. amar leh kudesha berich hu, chayyecha, behahu dina mammash, tehe dain, ma ketiv, (Iyov 2:Adonai) ulam shelach na yadcha vega el atzmo veel besaro vegomer. bema deihu dan, hachi ittedan. veaf al gav divchol shear hava dachil lekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, ach et nafsho shemor. veityehiv leh reshu, lemishlat al bisra, begin raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar ba lefanay veukemuha, ba lefanay vadday, veda ihu (338 109 amud alef) ketz kol basar, velo rucha. veittemar, deihu ketz deate missitra dechoshech, kema deat amer, (Iyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker. ulechol bisra, begin deit ketz achara, veikre (Daniel 12) ketz hayyamin, veda ihu ketz achara, missitra dismala, deihu choshech. veal da ityeyhiv leh reshu beatzmo uvesaro.

Vattesiteni vo levalleo. i hachi, lav bedina hava, ella bememar hahu mekatrega, deasit leh, veaste leh. ella, kolla bedina hava, vehachi amar lo elihu, (Iyov 34:11) ki foal adam yeshallem lo ucheorach ish yamtziennu. vehachi hava kema deittemar, kema deihu gazar, hachi itgezar aleh.

Vehay deamar vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam, vattesiteni levalleo la ketiv, ella vattesiteni vo, beh kayyeyma bedateh, deihu chashiv deha tesiteni, kema deamar (Iyov 10:3) veal atzat reshaim hofata. (amar Iyov itpattit al memar dehahu mekatrega) kegavvna da, (tehillim 75) vayfattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo. vayfattuhu vaychazzevu lo. la ketiv, ella vayfattuhu befihem. befihem kayyeyma milla da deha itpatta.
564: Amar ribbi abba, kolla hu shappir, aval hachi olifna, ditnan, salik veastin. vechi ihu yachil leastana, in. deha ihu (resh vayyeshev tikun 141) melech zaken uchesil, dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:13) tov yeled misken vechacham mimmelech zaken uchesil. veal da, yachil leastana levar nash. may taama. begin deihu meheman al ovadoy divne nasha.

Ta chaze, hay bedina deyachid, aval bedina dealma, ketiv, (Bereshit 11) vayyered Adonai lirot. (Bereshit 18:21) erada na vaere. dela ityeyhiv mehemanuta ella bideh bilchodoy, deha la baa leovada alma, al memar dehahu mekatrega, detiuveteh ihu tadir leshetzaa. menalan dichtiv, (Iyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker. leshetzaa kolla, hu choker. veda ihu ketz kol basar ba lefanay, vadday begin leshetzaa.

Veta chaze, vayhi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai. kema deittemar. vehahu yoma, kayymin teren sitrin, lekabbela beni alma. kol innun deatyayn kame kudesha berich hu bityuveta uveovadin tavin, innun zachyan lemeheve ketivin legabbeh dehahu sitra deihu chayyim, veappik totzot chayyim. uman deihu missitreh, achtiv lechayyim. vechol innun deatyayn beovadin bishin, innun ketivin lehahu sitra achara deihu mota, veikre (265 1) mavt, uveh sharya mota.

Uvehahu yoma, kayymin illen teren sitrin: chayyim, umavet. it man deachtiv lesitra dechayyim. veit man deachtiv lesitra demavet. ulezimnin dealma sharya beemtzaita, i kayyeyma chad zakkaa bealma, deachra alayyhu, kullehu kayymin veachtivu lechayyim. vei chad chayyayva achra alma, kullehu achtivu lemita.

Vehahu zimna, alma hava kayyaym beemtzaita, vehahu mekatrega baa leastaa. miyyad ma ketiv, hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz vegomer. kevan deishtemoda ihu bilchodoy, miyyad atkif beh mekatrega. veal da tanenan, dela itzterich leh levar nash leitparsha mikkelala desaggiin, begin dela yitreshim ihu bilchodoy, vela yekatregun aleh leella.

Dichtiv, bashshunammit, (Melachim 2 4:13) vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet. la beena leappaka garmay mikkelala desaggiin, betoch ammi yativna, ad yoma da, uvetoch ammi, bichlala chada ishtemoda leella. vehacha iyyov, kevan deishtemoda leella veitreshim, miyyad atkif beh mekatrega, veamar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim, kol ma dedachil lach veittakaf, lav lemaggana avid, halo atta sachta vaado uvead vegomer. aval tol kol hay tava deant aved leh, umiyyad im lo al panycha yevarchekka. yishbok lach, veyitdabbak besitra achara, deha hasheta befatorach ihu achil, salik patorach mineh, venecheze mimman ihu, uvean sitra yitdabbak.

Miyyad, vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hinne chol asher lo beyadecha. leachazaa, didchilu deiyyov legabbeh dekudesha berich hu, hu lenatra utereh. umehacha olifna, dechol innun dedachalin leh lekudesha berich hu, al uterayyhu, o al benayyhu, lav ihu dechilu kedka yeot. veal da kitreg hahu mekatrega veamar, hachinnam yare iyyov elohim halo atta sachta vaado vegomer maase yadav berachta. veal da ihu dachil lach veityeyhiv leh reshu lekatrega beh, uleachazaa, dela palach iyyov lekudesha berich hu birchimu.
Dechevan deitnasse, nafak meorcha, vela kaim bekiumeh, ma ketiv, bechol zot la chata iyyov bisfatav. lo chata bisfatav aval biruteh chata, ulevatar chata becholla.

Vei tema dela itnasse bar nash, ha ketiv (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan vegomer. uvegin kach itnasse iyyov. veaf al gav dela kaim bekiumeh kedka yeot, la nafak mittechot reshuta demareh leitdabbeka besitra achara.

Vechamma hava hahu nissuta dileh. teresar yarche, shuletanuta dehahu sitra achara. kema detanenan, dina dechayyavaya baggehinnam 12 yarche, uvegin dela itdabbak besitra achara ketiv, (Iyov 42:12) vaAdonai berach et
565: Rabbi shimon amar, hay deiyyov, lav nissuta ihu dekudesha berich hu, kenisuta dishar tzaddikayya, deha la ketiv vehaelohim nissa et iyyov, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. deavraham, ihu bideh akriv livreh yechiday dileh legabbe kudesha berich hu, veiyyov la yahiv kelum, vela masar leh lekudesha berich hu kelum.

Vela ittemar leh, deha galle kameh, dela yachil lekayyeyma beh, aval itmesar bida dimkatrega. uvedina dekudesha berich hu itavid, vekudesha berich hu ittear dina (bedina) da, lehahu mekatrega legabbeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 1:8) hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov vegomer.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 4:3) vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama. mikketz yamim, velo mikketz yamin. ihu dacha leketz yamin, veitkeriv leketz yamim. veha okimna, (Daniel 12:13) veatta lech leketz. veamar daniel, lean ketz, leketz hayyamin, o leketz hayyamim. ad deamar leh leketz hayyamin. veal da david dachil veamar, (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi, o leketz hayyamim o leketz hayyamin. vehacha ma ketiv vayhi mikketz yamim, velo mikketz yamin, uvegin kach la itkabbal karbaneh, deha missitra achara hava. (kolla)

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vehevel hevi gam hu. may gam hu. leasgaa da beda, karbaneh lekudesha berich hu hava kolla, veikara dekarbena lekudesha berich hu, veyahav chulaka lesitra achara, kema deat amer umechelvehen. vekayin, ikara aved mikketz yamim, raza desitra achara, veyahiv chulaka lekudesha berich hu, veal da la itkabbal.

Beiyyov ma ketiv, (Iyov 1:4) vehalchu vanav veasu mishte vegomer, veshalchu vekaru lishloshet achyotehem leechol velishtot immahem vayhi ki hikkifu yeme hammishte vegomer, uvemishteya bechol yoma mekatrega shechiach, vela yachil leh. mena lan. dichtiv, (Iyov 1:10) halo atta sachta vaado uvead beto uvead kol asher lo missaviv uleolam la yahiv chulaka kelal legabbeh, deha (nusach acher ma) ketiv (Iyov 1:Adonai) veheela olot mispar kullam. ola salleka leella leella, vela yahiv chulaka lesitra achara. deilmale yahav leh chulaka, la yachil leh levatar, vechol ma denatal middileh natal.

Vei tema amay avish leh kudesha berich hu. ella. deilmale yahav leh chulaka, yifni archa veyistelak meal makdesha, vesitra dikdushsha istelik leella leella. veihu la aved ken, veal da kudesha berich hu tava bedina.

Ta chaze, kema deihu itperash, vela achlil tov vara, ihu dan leh behahu gavvna, yahiv leh tov, ulevatar ra, ulevatar ahadreh letov. dehachi itchaze lebar nash, leminda tov, uleminda ra, uleahdara garmeh letov, veda ihu raza dimhemanuta. ta chaze, iyyov meavde paro hava, veda hu dichtiv beh, (Shemot 9:20) hayyare et devar Adonai meavde paro. ta chaze, dela baa kudesha berich hu leaakara iyyov meatreh deihu hava michse (nusach acher kola baa kudesha behach hu leakera meatrayyhu Iyov hava mechase) (nusach acher Iyov chakkim hava) al paro kevan deitchalash avad nukemin lefaro

Amar ribbi shimon, hasheta it legallaa razin, deinnun mitdabbekin leella vetatta, ma ketiv bo el paro, lech el paro mibbae leh, may bo. ella, deayil leh kudesha berich hu, iddarin batar iddarin, legabbe tannina chada illaa takkifa, dechamma dargin mishtalshelen minneh. uman ihu. raza dehattannin haggadol.
Umoshe dachil minneh, vela kariv ella legabbe innun yeorin, veinnun dargin dileh, aval legabbeh dachil vela kariv, begin dechama leh mishtarish besharashin illain.

Kevan dechama kudesha berich hu dedachil moshe, ushelichan memanan acharanin leella, la yachlin lekarva legabbeh. amar kudesha berich hu, (Yechezkel 29:3) hinni alecha paro melech mitzrayim hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav. vekudesha berich hu itzterich leaggacha beh kerava, velo achara. kema deat amar, ani Adonai, veukemuha raza dechachmeta dehattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav leinun mare middin, deyadin berazin demarehon.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Bereshit 1:21) vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim veet kol nefesh hachayya haromeset asher shartzu hammayim leminehem. hay kera ukemuha leh. aval vayyivra elohim et hattanninim hu raza da
566: Livyatan uvat zugo. (176 amud bet) tanninim chaser ketiv, begin dekatal lenukeba, vesalleka kudesha berich hu letzaddikayya. veukemuha.

Hattannim haggadol, tesha yeorin innun, deihu ravitz benayyhu, vechad yeora ihu, dememav shechichin, uverechan dememin deginta, naflin beh telat zimnin beshatta. vechad teren zimnin, mitbarech hahu yeora velo kol kach, vechad chad lav hachi.

Vehay tannina, al behahu yeora, ittakif veazil veshat al go yamma, uvala nunin lechamma zinin, veshalit, vetav lehahu yeora. illen tisha yeorin azlin vesallekin vesacharaneh kamma ilanin. vaasavin lezinayyhu.

Yeora kadmaa, nafka missitra semala, bechad tzinnora denagid venafik, telat tippin, vechol tippa vetippa itperash litlat tippin, vechol tippa vetippa itavid minneh yeora chad, veillen innun tisha yeorin, demittakfin veazlin veshatan vesacharan bechol innun rekiin.
Mimma deishtear meinnun tippin kad sayymin lemefak, ishtear tippa chada, denafka bishchichu, nafal benayyhu, veitavid minneh yeora chada. hay yeora ihu, hahu deamaran deazla bishchichu.

Hay yeora, kad hahu nahar denagid venafik, appik tippin acharanin ravreva (sefer acher 277) missitra dimina, ma deishtear meinnun tippin, ishtear tippa chada bishchichu meinnun birkan, venafal behahu yeora deihu shachich. vehay ihu yeora deadif mikkullehu.

Kad nafkin umitparshan innun arba naharin denafkin migginta deeden, hahu deikre pishon, nafil behahu yeora veitkelil beh. veal da malchut bavel, itkelil behay. ufishon ihu malchut bavel. miyora da ittezanu veitmalyayn kol innun yeorin acharanin.

Bechol yeora viora, azla veshat chad tannina, veinnun tesha. vechol chad vechad nakiv nukeba beresheh, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 74:13) shibbarta rashe tanninim vegomer. vaafillu hay hattannin haggadol hachi hu, begin dechullehu nafchin ruchin legabbe ella velo letatta.

Ketiv (Bereshit 1:1) bereshit bara elohim. uchetiv vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim, bechol ovada deinnun eser amiran, kayymin lekavlayyhu innun eser yeorin. vechad tannina mitparpera (sefer acher mitparsha) (sefer acher materaperapea) berucha, lekavel kol chad vechad.

Veal da, chad leshivin shenin mizdaza alma, begin dehay hattannin haggadol kad hu salik senappiroy veizdaza, keden kullehu mizdazean beinnun yeorin, vechol alma mizdazea, veara mitchalchelet, vechullehu kelilan behay tannin haggadol.

Vehaaretz hayta tohu vegomer, amar ribbi shimon, ovada divreshit, chavrayya laan beh, veyadin beh, aval zeirin innun, deyadin lerammeza ovada divreshit, beraza detannin haggadol. veal da tanenan, dechol alma la mishtalshela ella al senappiroy deda.

Ta chaze vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vegomer, tanenan hayta, veokimna. begin dibbehay yeora kadmaa dekamran, kad hay hattannin haggadol al beh, keden itmalyay, vesati vedaich nitzotzin deitlekatu beinnun almin deitcharavu bekadmita.

Innun tanninin acharanin dekamran, havo vela havo, amay. begin deitchalash chelayyhu dela yetashteshun alma, bar leshivin shenin, chad zimna, veinnun ittekafu bechela dehahu tannin haggadol, vehay ihu bilchodoy leittatkefa. veilmale nukeveh kayyemet legabbeh, la yachil alma lemisbal lon. (uvegin kach)

Ad la katal kudesha berich hu lenukeba, haaretz hayta tohu. (vavohu) tohu hayta. ulevatar dekatal lah, hava (Bereshit 70 amud alef) bohu, sharat leitkayyeyma. vechoshech al. ad la havat nehira ovada deavad.

Me avid kudesha berich hu, machatz resheh didchura leella, veitkafya, begin deha tehoma letatta, la hava nahir. may tama la hava nahir, begin dehay hattannin haggadol, hava nashiv rucha al tehoma, veachshich leh, vela merafrefa letatta.

Veavar (nusach acher veim kol da) rucha achara dilella, venashav (nusach acher daneshab) uvatash behahu rucha, veshachich leh, hada hu dichtiv veruach elohim merachefet al peni hammayim. vehayeynu detanenan, dekudesha berich hu batash rucha berucha, uvara alma.
Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or, nahir nehiru dilella, uvatash
567: Al gabbe rucha denashiv, veistallak meal tehoma, vela chafa leh. kevan dithoma itnehir, veihu istallak, keden hava nehiru.

Da nahir al resheh, umayya havo nafke miggo afuteh, verucha nashiv leella. venahir minnehiru da, ad dehava nachit nehoreh, menatznetza leshivin uteren nehorin deshimsha, kevan deinnun nehorin itreshimu bego shimsha letatta, havo (188 amud alef) chayyayvayya dealma yadin behu, vahavu palchin leshimsha. kevan deistakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun chayyayvayya, salik nehoreh veganiz leh amay ganiz leh. begin dehahu tannin, hava salik venachit, uvatash beinun yeorin, ad deganaz leh vela itgalya.
Vezara leh zerua bechad tzaddik, deihu gannana deginta, uzerua dezara beginta, bignizu bitmiru (sefer acher hay) dehay or ihu.

Kad hay hattannin haggadol, chame detzamach beginta zerua deor da, keden ittear lesitra achara, lehahu nahar deikre gichon. veitpelagu memoy dehay gichon, chad shevila dileh, ihu azil go hahu zerua deatzmecha go ginta, veanhir beh birvu dizrua da, veikre gichon.

Umiggo hahu revu dizrua da, istelak lirvu deshlomo malka, kad istelak lemalchu, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 1:33-34) vehoradtem oto el gichon, uchetiv umashach oto sham. sham, velo baatar achara, begin dehava yada david malka da, umemoy acharanin istalaku lemalchu achara, veda ihu malka deihu takkifa.

Vehay hattannin haggadol, ittear leh, veistallak senappiroy dehay tannin, behahu nahar, leittatkefa beh. vechol innun shear yeorin kullehu, sallekin venachtin betukpa dehay hattannin haggadol, vetaav veal lehahu yeora shechicha, veishtechach beh.

Ucheden, kad hahu or itgeniz (sefer acher lenatla) leiula leh hahu gannana dekamran, keden nafak choshech kadmaa, uvatash al resheh, behahu nukeba deitmattecha beh, veitperash chad chuta, ben hahu nehiru deor da deitgeniz, uven hahu chashocha dechoshech da, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech.
Hay tannin, tav behahu perishu dehay chuta deafrish, veafrish leinun (nusach acher ben inun) yeorin, go chashocha, veitperashu nunin lezinayyhu illen meillen, behahu perishu.
Vechad itperashu mayin illain kaddishin. kol innun yeorin itperashu, vealu lego hahu yeora shechicha deitberir mikkullehu, venafik vealin beh telat (balak 196) zimnin beyoma.

Vechol innun nunin dimgaddelan go innun yeorin, perishan illen meillen, veikrun lelot, veillen innun rashin lechol innun nunin denafkin levar, veillen shaltin al kullehu. veillen ikrun bechore mitzrayim, umehacha itbadar levar bucherin, vechullehu ittezanu mishshakyu deinnun yeorin. vehay hattannin haggadol, shalta al kullehu.

Vecholla bifrishu demayin illain, dichtiv vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim, veitreshimu mayin kaddishin illain, veitperashu leella, umayin tattain, itperashu kullehu illen meillen, kaddishin udela kaddishin, veal da ikrun malachin illain perishan, begin deitperashu illen meillen lezinayyhu.

Vayyomer elohim tadshe haaretz deshe esev mazria zera, raza da, kad hay hattannin haggadol, hava nashiv rucha behahu nukeba, umerafrefa legabbe ella, kol innun asavin hava mehappech lon livishu, ad derucha achara nashiv behahu rucha, veshachich leh letatta, vaasavin tzamchu kemillekaddemin. veshaltin umeshabbechan veodan kame kudesha berich hu.

Missetar semala, ulego yeora shechicha, nafkin beirin lezinayyhu, veazlin lemikrav legabbe deinnun asavin vela yachlin, vetavin leatrayyhu. kol illen yeorin azlin veshatin, im hahu tannina deshalit behu, vesacharin leinun asavin, vela yachlin. bar lezimnin, derucha illaa la nashiv, veihu merafrefa rucha behahu nukeba dilella, kema deokimna, keden shalit hahu rucha al innun asavin.

Viora shechicha tav leatreh, vesalleka venachta. uvegin dememoy shechichin, azil bishchichu, vehay hattannim haggadol salleka legabbe innun yeorin, vaasavin kullehu megaddelan sacharaneh dehahu yeora shechicha veillen (nusach acher veinnun) megaddelin bechol ivar, keden salleka hahu tannina veitrabbe benayyhu, vetav lechol innun yeorin.
Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim, da ihu nachash bariach. amay bariach. begin desagir litren sitrin, vela nafik lealmin ella chad zimna leyovla.
Uvesifre kadmae, da nachash akallaton, deihu beakkimu tadir, veayyte levavtin al alma, kad hay kam, ittevar tukepeh
568: Dehahu tannina, vela yachil lemekam, ad deavid gishmeh. begin dekudesha berich hu kafif leh go yamma, kad al legabbeh. veihu darach al tukpeh deyamma. vetukpeh deyamma da, ihu tannina, kema deat amer (Iyov 9:8) vedorech al bomote yam.

Vechad hay nachash kam, keden ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 27:1) veharag et hattannin asher bayyam, da ihu hattannin haggadol. veal da ketiv, (Yechezkel 29:3) hinni alecha. veda nachash, ihu meorot, bilvavtin lecholla, begin deihu takkifa aleh, betukpeh dehahu nahar ravreva, deikre chiddekel, veha okimna.

Hahu nachash ihi beyabbeshta kad nafkin da beda, da divyabbeshta ittekaf tadir, begin dechol orchoy vetokfoy beyabbeshta ihu, veachil ara veafra tadir, kema deat amer (Bereshit 3:14) veafar tochal kol yeme chayyecha. da gaddil beafra, veda gaddil bemayya. nachash deitgaddil bemayya, lav takkifa kehay deitgaddil beyabbeshta, veal da ketiv (Bereshit 1) meorot chaser.

Veda izdaman legabbe hahu demayya. veaf al gav (veda lo) deizdeman legabbeh, la agach legabbeh, ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, dekatil leh miggo yamma, kema deokimna begin gassut rucha deveh, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 29) asher amar li yeori vegomer.

Veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim vegomer. tana amar ribbi yose, hay kera kashya, vechi veraa et haddam veachar kach ufasach, demashma desimana hu deavid. vei tema begin dama deihu mitzva, amay levar. vaamay bitlat duchete defitcha. veha ketiv (Daniel 2:22) hu galle amikata vegomer. umay tama baa deitgalya dama al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot.

Ella tana, ketiv, (Devarim 32) vayyar Adonai vayyinatz, uchetiv, (Bereshit 6:Adonai) vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz. vetanenan la itchaze ashgachuta dilella, ella kad itchaze letatta ovada deitavedu ovada minneh veal da (nusach acher vead deavdin ovada letatta) la mashgichin (nusach acher leavasha), bar hirhura deavoda zara, dichtiv, (Devarim 11:16) hishshamru lachem pen yifte levavchem. umiddeitaved ovada, ashgachuta dilella ittear, uvegin kach, kolla, ben letav uven levish, beovada talya milleta.

Amar ribbi yose, kol shevake mitzrayim, malyayn taavavn havo, veod divchol beta uveta, havo shechiche zinin, demitkatre becharashayyhu, beinnun kitrin tattain diltatta, umitarin ruach misava begavavyyhu.

Veraza demilla tana, ketiv, ulekachtem aguddat ezov utevaltem baddam asher bassaf vehiggatem el hammashkof veel shete hammezuzot. aguddat ezov lamma. begin levaara ruach misava mibbenayyhu, (nusach acher hay kera kashya vechi veraa et haddam veachar kach ufesach demashma daseymenaa hu deavid amay veha kolla galeyya kammeh kudesha berich hu uchetiv hu galle amikta umesatterata ella tanna ketiv vayyar Adonai vayyinatz vegomer uchetiv vayyar Adonai ki Rabba raat vegomer vetanenan lo itchaze ashgachuta leella ella kad itchaze letatta ovada vamedaataabad ovada ashgachuta leella ittear uvegin kach kola ben letav ben levish beovada talyay milleta. ulekachtem agevadet ezov vegomer agevadet ezov lamma umay tama baa deitgalyay dema al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot. amar rabbi yose kol shevake mitzrayim malyayn taavavn havo uvechol beta uveta havo shechiche zinin damekaterayn becharshayyhu beinnun bitren tattain diltatta umitarin ruach misava begavvayyhu veal da agevadet ezov begin labearea ruchi mibbenayyhu) uleachazaa befitchayyhu, behane telat duchete, mehemanuta shelemata. chad hacha, vechad hacha, vechad begavavyyhu begin kach, ufasach Adonai al happetach velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battechem lingof, mishshum dechame shema kaddisha rashim al pitcha.
Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi amay dama, deha tanenan, chivvavr vesumak vechad dechalil bene gavvne. amar leh, tere dame havo, chad demila, vechad defischa. demila rachame. defischa dina.

Amar ribbi yehuda, lav hachi, ella kema deolifna, deachzar hahu dama kudesha berich hu lerachame, keillu havo chivvavr bego gavvne, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 16:6) vaeevor alayich vaerech mitboseset bedamayich veomar lach bedamayich chayi vegomer. veaf al gav dehava sumaka, itchazar lerachame, dichtiv bedamayich chayi. uvegin kach, rashim pitcha bitlat sitrin, chad hacha, vechad hacha, vechad benayyhu.
Tane Rabbi chizkiyya, teren dame itchazu, lokovel tere kitrin, deitchazu (nusach acher deitaru) leella behahi shaata. amar ribbi yose, chad kitra dichlila bitren sitrin temirin,
569: Amar ribbi abba, bechamma atrin chas kudesha berich hu al benoy: aved bar nash beta, vekudesha berich hu amar leh, ketov shemi, veshavve lefitchach, veat share lego beta, vaana otiv levar befitchach lenatra lach. vehacha amar, rashim al pitcha raza dimhemanuta dili, veat share lego betach, vaana natir lach levar, dichtiv veattem lo tetzeu ish mippetach beto ad boker, uchetiv veraa et haddam al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot ufasach 4 al happetach velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battechem lingof.

Tu amar ribbi abba, kegavvna dishma kaddisha avadu behahu shaata. ma shema kaddisha 5 itchazar behay shaata dina, uf hachi itchazar hay dama behay shaata dina, dichtiv veraa et haddam al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot, reshima dechullehu sumaka, leitchazaa, deha itchazar bedina, lemebad nukemin.

Veraza demilla, kegavvna dehave leella behahu shaata, kad bae leitchazaa letatta, i rachame rachame, vei dina dina, hada hu dichtiv, utevaltem baddam asher bassaf vehiggatem vegomer. ulezimna deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra. dezammin leachazaa (nusach acher laatachezarea) kullehu dina lemebad nukemin.

Veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker. may taama, mishshum detanenan, amar ribbi yitzchak, (amar rabbi yirmeya) la livae leh leinish lemezal beshuka, uleishtakkecha beshuka, bezimna dedina talya bemata, dechevan dirshuta ityeyhiv limchabbela, man defaga beh ittezak. vehacha mishshum dedina ishtechach, la baya lenafka levar.

Tanya amar ribbi yose, behahu mammash deishtechach dina lemitzrae, behahu mammash ishtechach rachame leyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, veraiti et haddam ufasachti alechem. vechen tana, bechol innun kitrin kaddishin dilella, kema deishtechach dina, ishtechach rachame, vecholla beshaata chada. tana ribbi chizkiyya, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 19:22) venagaf Adonai et mitzrayim nagof verafo. nagof lemitzrayim, verafo leyisrael. may verafo. mimay shennimolu tzerichim refua.

Vetana, beota shaa shenniggefu mitzrae, beota shaa nitrappeu yisrael. detanya amar ribbi yose, (amar rabbi chizkiyya) mahu dichtiv, ufasach Adonai al happetach, may al happetach. ufasach Adonai alechem mibbae leh. aval al happetach, al happetach mammash zehu petach hagguf. vee zehu petach hagguf. hve omer zo mila.

Ribbi shimon amar, beshaata deitpelag lelya, vechitra kaddisha ittear legabbah (nusach acher itarav beh) dechura. uman dechura. chesed illaa, demashma, deda bela da la salleka, uvegin da, da mache, veda masse, vecholla beshaata chada.

Uchetiv, ufasach Adonai al happetach hayyadua. may happetach, mishshum deihu pitcha umeshicha derucha vegufa, veta chaze, ad la itgezar avraham, hava atim vesatim mikkol sitroy. middeitgezar itpetach mikkolla, vela have atim vesatim kekadmita.

Vehayeynu raza detanenan, (Bereshit 18:1) vehu yshev petach haohel. mishshum deitgalyay yod. may ka mayyre. ella amar ribbi yitzchak dehu ashre begilluya da, chesed betzedek. veda hu pitcha, demashkena illaa kaddisha, mashma dichtiv haohel, haohel hayyadua.

Amar ribbi elazar, kad itgalleyay hay yod, itbassar, (nusach acher atebashem) veitberach befetach haohel, dehi tzedek, leitbassema bechesed. hada hu dichtiv, kechom hayyom, dehu shaata deshalta chesed, chulaka deavraham. umena lan dehay petach haohel, itbassam lekavleh deavraham. dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol, deitbassam bechesed, middeitgalyay yod.

Amar ribbi abba, vehu yoshev petach haohel, kema dichtiv vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. deda hu pitcha kaddisha, kitra ashiraa. kechom hayyom, kema deityeyhiv leh kitra dechesed, hada hu dichtiv kechom hayyom. kema deyativ behay, kach yativ behay, dela salik hay belo hay.
570: Veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim. may veavar. deavar al shure dina dechitrin, (nusach acher daketareyn) dahavo mitkashshere bechitrin acharanin dilella, veshara lehu mikkiyyomehon, veavar al orchoy, begin lemebad behu dina, ulenatra lehu leyisrael, ucheden hu, kol veavar, veavarti, vayyaavor, dekudesha berich hu avar al kol orchoy, o ledina, o lerachame. hacha veavar, begin lemebad dina, hatam vayyaavor, begin lerachama.

Vayhi bachatzi hallayla vaAdonai hikka kol bechor vegomer. (ketiv 0 vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon vegomer) Rabbi chiyyay 206 yose havo azle meusha lelud, vahava ribbi chiyyay rachiv bechamra. amar Rabbi yose, netiv hacha venatzle, deha mata zimna ditzlota demincha, vetanenan, leolam yehe adam zahir bitzlota demincha. amay zahir. mishshum dehi shaata detalya dina uvae bar nash lechavvevna dateh, nachat Rabbi chiyyay vetzalle.

Ad dahavo azle, nata shimsha lemeal. amar ribbi chiyyay ler yose amay at shatik. amar ribbi yose, mistakkel havena bedatay, delet alma mitkayyeyma, ella al reshehon deamma. i reshe amma zakkain, tav lealma, tav leamma. vei la zakkain, vavy lealma, vavy leamma.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday kach hu, menalan. dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 18:16) raiti et kol yisrael nefotzim al heharim ketzon asher en lahen roe vayyomer Adonai lo adonim laelle yashuvu ish leveto beshalom. yashuvu, yeshvu mibbae leh. leveto, beveto mibbae leh. deha beatrayyhu kayyme.

Ella hachi tanenan, i resha deamma la zache, amma mittafsan bechoveh. menalan. dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 24:17) vayyomer david vegomer hinne anochi chatati veanochi heeveti veelle hatztzon me asu, (sefer acher uchetiv 1 vaani hu asher chatati vegomer) david chav, veyisrael savlu. vei resha deamma mitpas bechoveh, amma mishtezvan. deha dina la sharya alayyhu. dichtiv, vayyomer Adonai lo adonim laelle, kelomar, (sefer acher im ellu) illu la havo reshin leamma, mehay orcha yashuvu ish leveto beshalom. kullehu mishtezvan, i reshehon mittafsan. vaafillu yehoshafat itgezar aleh leitannesha, mishshum deitchabbar beachav. i lav hahu tzevavcha, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 22:32) vayyizak yehoshafat.
Ad dahavo azle ramash lelya, amru, ma navid, i nezil chashach lelya, i netiv dachala hu. satu meorcha, yatvu techot ilana chad. veyatvu vahavu amre mille deorayyta, vela demichu.

Befalgut lelya, chamu chad ayyalta deavra kamayyhu, vahavat tzavchat uremiat kalin shamu, kamu Rabbi chiyyay 206 yose veizdaazau. shamu chad kala demachreza veamar, mitarin kumu. nayymin ittearu. almin, izdemanu lekadmat marechon. (deha kala nafak dakeayb ayalleta dilella vetatta. dichtiv 0 kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot vaychashevaf yaravet) deha marechon mafik legan eden, deihu hechaleh, leishtashea im tzaddikayya, dichtiv uvehechalo kullo omer kavod.
Amar ribbi chiyyay, hasheta palgu delelya mammash. vekala da, hu kala denafak, vechaiv ayyalta dilella vetatta, dichtiv kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot. zakkaa chulakana, dezachena lemishma da.

Veta chaze raza demilla, beshaata dekudesha berich hu itchaze al (vayyetze 176) ginta, kol ginta itkenash, vela mitperash meeden. umehay eden mabbue nafkin, lechamma orchin ushevilin, vehay ginta, itkere tzerora (173) dechayye, detamman mitaddenin tzaddikayya, minnehiru dealma deate. uvehay shaata, kudesha berich hu itgele alayyhu. vetanenan beshaata dekudesha berich hu itar beginta deeden leishtaashea im tzadikayyay karoza nafik vekare uri tzafon uvoi teman hafichi gani yizzelu besamav yavo dodi legano veyochal peri megadav may veyochal peri megadav ilen korbanin deitkeravu kammeh minishmattehon detzadikayyay hay befalgut lelya beshaata achara shear korbanin mammash.

Yatvu ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, amar ribbi yose, bechamma zimnin shailna, hay dichtiv, vayhi bachatzi hallayla vaAdonai hikka chol bechor beeretz mitzrayim amay la hava bimama, deyitgele lechol pirsume nisa, vaamay mitu kol innun challashe devatar rechayyay, veinnun talyay divne ana, vela mitu malche ufardashche, veguvere maggiche kerava, kema dehava besancheriv, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 19:35) vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachane ashshur vegomer. vetanenan, kullehu malchin bene malchin rufinus ufardashche, hatam
571: Itchaze gevureta dechad shelicha dileh, yattir mehay, dehava yeot lemeheve dilleh yattir.

Amar leh yeot shaalt, vaana la shemana midi behay, vela ema, aval ha zachena lechol hay, vearcha ittekan kaman. ana shemana deribbi shimon ben yochay madche shevakin ditverya, nezil gabbeh. yatvu, ad dehava nahir yemama. kad salik nehora, kamu veazle. kad matu gabbeh. ashkechuhu, dehava yativ, vesifra deaggadta bideh.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 40:17) kol haggoyim keayin negdo meefes vatohu nechshevu lo. kevan deamar, kol haggoyim keayin negdo, lamma ketiv meefes vatohu nechshevu lo. ella olifna, datayyhu dechol ammin dealma, dimhemanuta dilhon hu keayin, dela idbaku illain vetattain, (betattain) veshavyayn lakavlayyhu mehemanuta dishtuta, aval meefes vatohu nechshevu lo, kehay ilola, desachara (sefer acher defarcha) berucha, umitgalgela bekayta berekanyya, hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 4:32) vechol dayyeyre ara kela chashivin.

Od patach veamar, bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz, et da yemina dekudesha berich hu, veet da semala. olifna, desata kudesha berich hu yemineh, uvara yat shemayya, vesata semala, uvara yat ara. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:13) af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim kore ani alehem yaamdu yachdav.

Mahu yaamdu yachdav. salleka datach shemayya veara lav hachi, (nusach acher mehashshamayim kore ani alehem vehaaretz lav hachi) ella yemina usemala deinnun et veet, veheach yaamdu yachdav. bezot hahi, deshalta befalgut lelya, dichlila et bezot.

Vetaninan, ketiv (Kohelet 3:11) et hakkol asa yafe veitto. et, ha deamaran. hakkol, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. vetana, dehi kitra deitkere zot, dichlila meet veet. veshalta befalgut lelya, bitren sitroy, berachame vedina, rachame leyisrael, vedina leammin ovde kochavim umazzalot.

Patach Rabbi chiyyay veamar, i nicha kameh demor, denema chad milla, al ma deatena ketiv, vayhi bachatzi hallayla vaAdonai hikka chol bechor beeretz mitzrayim. umehay deamar mor, ishtema dehay pesuka behahu milla ata vaanan orcha ittakna kamman, lemete lemishal kammach.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 113:5) mi kaAdonai elohenu hammagbihi lashavet vegomer. mi kaAdonai elohenu, desalik veitattar leityashsheva bechitra illaa kaddisha, nehiru al kol butzini denaharu kitrin veitterin. hammashpili lirot, denachit bechitroy, mikkitra lechitra, minnizra lenizra, minnehiru linhiru, mibbutzina levutzina. leashgecha beillain vetattain, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 14:2) Adonai mishshamayim hishkif al bene adam vegomer.

Ta chaze, ketiv, vayhi bachatzi hallayla. kachatzi mibbae leh, o kachatzot, kegavvna deamar moshe. vei kema deamre chavrana, dela yiyimrun itztagnine paro, moshe badday hu. ha kusheya beatreh kayyeyma, 5 gavvne, deafillu yisrael yemrun hachi. chad, dei hachi hava leh lememar vayyomer moshe kachatzot hallayla. amay kaamar, ko amar Adonai vegomer. kema dela itkevavn shaata, deha la yittafsun bemoshe, ella befatrona, begin deamar ko amar Adonai vegomer. tere, deha moshe amar, ad bechor hashshifcha asher achar harechayim, vela hava hachi, ella ad bechor hashshevi asher bevet habbor. al kol panim afillu yisrael name yiyimrun hachi, deha la itbarrun mille. telat deihu amar mishma defatrona kachatzot, uchetiv vayhi bachatzi hallayla.

Veod, sheelta dilchon, yattir al matul dela yachil beira lemisbal. amay hava befalgut lelya, vela bimama. vaamay mitu kol innun challashin devatar rechayya. ella kolla raza illaa hu, ben mechatztzede chakla, vecholla itkeshar (nusach acher itbassar) binvia mehemana.

Zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dealeh ketiv (tehillim noah) yafyafita mibbene adam hutzak chen besiftotecha al ken berachcha elohim leolam. ahavta tzedek vattisna resha al ken meshachacha elohim elohecha shemen
572: Sason mechaverecha. yafyafita mibbene adam: mishshet vachanoch. hutzak chen besiftotecha: minnoach uvanav. al ken meshachacha elohim elohecha: meavraham veyitzchak. shemen sason: miyyaakov. mechaverecha: mishshear nevie. vechi gever desalik bedargin illain dela salik bar nash achara, la yada ma deamar.

Ella hachi tanenan, hay kitra deikre zot, itkere ishsha, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:23) lezot yikkare ishsha. amay. mishshum ki meish lukkocha zot. man hu ish. hahu deikre ze. veda hu ish dechar, kema deat amer (Shemot 32:1) ki ze moshe haish. haish hazze. veikre ish ze, veze ish. vezot, itnesivat mizze deikre zachar.

Uvegin da, ihi tamar dechar venukeba, dela salik da belo da. tamar: kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 3:6) ketimrot ashan. ma ashan, salik chivvavr veucham, uf hacha, kolla kalil bah befalgut lelya, lemebad nimusoy bechad shaata, chivvavr leyisrael, veucham leovde avodat kochavim umazzalot.

Veod dehay lelya la itpelag, la avid nimusoy. mena lan. meavraham. dichtiv, (Bereshit 14:15) vayyechalek alehem layla, deitpelag lemebad nimusoy. (mahu kachatzot kema deat amar 1 kaalot hammincha 2 kaalot gadish uf hacha kachatzot) kemiflag. demoshe yada dela yabed nimusoy, ad deitpelag.

Vehachi hava, dela avid lelya nimusoy, ad deitpelag, befalgut batraa, aved nimusoy, hada hu dichtiv vayhi bachatzi hallayla. may bachatzi. befalgut batraa, bezimna deihi shalta, veishtechach hay zot, lemebad nimmusin tadira, vechol nimusa deitavid belelya, befalguta batraa itavid.

VaAdonai hikka chol bechor, vaAdonai: hu uvet dino, vaAdonai: hu venimusoy. hikka chol bechor hikka, moshe lo amar ella umet vegomer, mahu hikka. ella, deittear ko, kema deagzim moshe, dichtiv vehinne lo shamata ad ko.

Vetana, paro chakkim hava mikkol charashoy, veistakkal behay zot, deyaaved beh dina, vezamin lecharva areh, kema deamar moshe, bezot teda ki ani Adonai. uveihu ma ketiv, vayyifen paro. mahu vayyifen. deafne libbeh mehirhura da. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 12:10) vayyifen aharon. vayyavo el beto velo shat libbo gam lezot. gam lerabbot hay dizmina lecharva areh, vela shave libbeh lokovleh dezot.

Chol bechor, afillu dargin illain vetattain, ittebaru mishshuletanehon, (sefer acher mashelashevaleyhevan) chol innun deshaltin bechachmeta dilhon, dichtiv, beeretz mitzrayim. vechullehu dargin, illain vetattain, deittebaru mishshuletanihon, (sefer acher mashelashevaleyhevan) kullehu bifsuka itchazun, (sefer acher itremizu) dichtiv mibbechor paro hayyoshev al kiso ad bechor hashshifcha asher achar harechayim vechol bechor behema, ha kullehu itchazun bifsuka.

Setama demilla, mibbechor paro hayyoshev al kiso, kitra tattaa dekuzemita demalchuta (nusach acher mamelakevatea) dilella. ad bechor hashshifcha, kitra semala, tattaa minah, dekuzemita mibbatar arba (nusach acher maketareh achar) rechayyin, arba mashiryayn. (450) mishshum dichtiv achar harechayim, (velo min harechayim.) vechol bechor behema, tattain mittattain, nukeba minnukevta, deishtechachu beatane bivire vachamare, beravreve bezutere, umekabbelin minnehon guverin venukevin. ad bechor hashshevi asher bevet habbor, innun denafkin mishshifcha. di behon avdin laasire, deyishtabedun behon lealmin, vela yifkun lecheru.

Uveruchetzanuta deillen dargin, sarivu mitzrae, di behon avadu kishra leyisrael, dela yifkun min avdutehon lealmin. uvehay itchaze gevureta veshultanuta dekudesha berich hu, veduchrana da la yishtetze miyyisrael ledare
573: Darin, dei la hava chela ugevureta dekudesha berich hu, kol malche ammin, vechol charashe almin, vechakkime almin, la yifkun leyisrael min avduta, deshara kitrin dilhon, vetavar kol innun kitrin, begin leappaka lon. al da ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha.

Bacha rabbi shimon, arim kaleh veatnach, amar kintura dekitfa ishtechach, chashavtun deshavach kudesha berich hu kamma zimnin, (Devarim Adonai:6) asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, (Devarim 16:3) hotziacha Adonai elohecha mimmitzrayim, (Devarim Adonai:15) vayyotziacha Adonai elohecha mishsham, (Shemot 12:17) hotzeti et tzivotechem, (Shemot 13:3) zachor et hayyom hazze asher yetzatem mimmitzrayim, (Devarim 14) vayyotziacha befanav bechocho haggadol mimmitzrayim, (Shemot 13:3) hotzi Adonai etchem mizze.

Ella tana, 10 kitrin, innun letatta, kegavvna dilella, vechullehu setimin, bitlata illen deamaran. utelat kishrin keshiru behu, al 3 dargin illen divhu avdu, deyisrael la yifkun mishshibudehon lealmin.

Zakkain attun avraham yitzchak veyaakov, devizchutechon shariu kitrin, vekudesha berich hu dechar telat kitre mehemanuta dilchon hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 2:24) vayyizkor elohim et berito et avraham et yitzchak veet yaakov. et avraham, ha kishra chada, deavraham. et yitzchak, ha kishra tinyayna, deyitzchak. veet yaakov, ha kishra telitaa, shelemata deyaakov.

Tana, kol zimnin vechaggin veshabbatin, kullehu ducherana lehay, veal hay itkayymu kullehu, deilmale hay, la hava netura dezimnin vechaggin veshabbatin. uvegine kach, la ishtetze duchrana demitzrayim mikkol zimnin vechaggin veshabbatin. ta chaze dina (sefer acher 5) hu yesoda vesharasha deorayyta, vechol pikudoy, vechol mehemanuta shelemata deyisrael.

Veod amay la hava bimama deshailtu. tanenan, ketiv hayyom attem yotzim, uchetiv hotziacha Adonai elohecha mimmitzrayim layla. ella tana, ikara defurekana deyisrael, la hava ella ballayla, delelya shara kitrin, veavid nukemin, veyoma appik lon beresh galle, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 33:3) yatzu bene yisrael beyad rama leene kol mitzrayim. (nusach acher veod layla share katrin vaavad nukemin vedinin veyoma galle ufirsem nissa vanevakemaa deitavid hada hu dichtiv yatzu bene yisrael beyad rama vegomer.) uchetiv umitzrayim mekabberim et asher hikka Adonai bahem kol bechor, da hu pirsume nisa.

Atu Rabbi chiyyay 206 yose, ishtetachu kameh, venashku yedoy. uvachu veamru, gelifin illain vetattain, zakfan resha beginach, aved kudesha berich hu yerushalayim letatta, kegavvna dilella. aved (512) shure karta kaddisha vetaroy. man deayil, la ayel, ad deyiftechun tarin. man desalik, la salik, ad deyittaknun dargin deshure man yachil lemiftach tarin dekarta kaddisha, uman yachil leatkena dargin deshure, da ribbi shimon ben yochay, deihu patach tarin deraze dechachmeta, veihu atkin dargin illain, uchetiv (Shemot la) yerae kol zechurecha et pene haadon Adonai. man pene haadon Adonai, da ribbi shimon ben yochay, deman deihu dechura min dechurnay, bae leitchazaa kameh.

Amar lon, ad hasheta, la siyyaymna milla dishelta dilchon, deha tanenan, vaAdonai hikka chol bechor, chol bechor setam, kidkamran. vecholla hava kema deinnun demitu, innun keture kitrin, dahavo mishtammeshe becharashayyhu beinnun kitrin. minhon mishtammeshe beillae, uminhon betattae, veaf al gav dechullehu tattain innun. vechol ara demitzrayim malya charashin hava. uchetiv ki en bayit asher en sham met.

Veitavid dina becholla, beshaata deitkenashu kullehu bevattehon, vela havo mitpazzere bemadbera uvechakla, ella kullehu ishtechachu bevattehon, (veor hanner yafe livdika mibbachutz) veavid lelya dinoy becholla behahi shaata. vetana hava nahir lelya keyoma ditkufa detammuz, vechama kol amma dinoy dekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 139:12) velayla kayyom yair kachashecha kaora.
Uveshaata denafku ishtechachu kullehon metin bashshevakin leenehon decholla, bayayn leakvera lehu vela ashkachu, veda akshe lehu mikkolla. chamu leyisrael nafkin
574: Leenehon bechad gisa, vechamu lemetehon beidach gisa. uvecholla hava pirsume nisa, dela hava kehay miyyoma deitbere alma.

Veta chaze, ketiv lel shimurim hu laAdonai lehotziam vegomer, hu hallayla hazze laAdonai shimurim lechol bene yisrael vegomer, hay pesuka kashya kevan deamar lel, mahu shimurim, vela shimmur, shimmur mibbae leh. uchetiv hu hallayla hazze, lel kaamar bekadmita, uvatar layla.

Ella hachi tanenan, ketiv, (Devarim 22:23) ki yihye naara vetula. naar ketiv, may tama. mishshum dechol zeman dela kabbilat dechar, itkere naar, middekabbilat dechar, itkere naara. uf hacha, lel ad la kabbilat dechar. veaf al gav dichtiv beh shimurim dechar hava zammin leitchabbera immah uveshaata deitchabbar immah dechar, ketiv, hu hallayla hazze laAdonai shimurim. shimurim: dechar venukeba. uvegine kach ketiv hallayla hazze.

Uvaatar deishtechachu dechar venukeba, let shevacha ella lidchura. vehachi shabbachu yisrael betushebachtayyhu. lidchura vela lenukeba, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:2) ze eli veanvehu. delet shevacha beatar didchura venukeba ishtechachu, ella lidchura. veal da (nusach acher valda) mechakkan yisrael, dichtiv, (yeshaya 12) ze Adonai kivvinu lo nagila venismecha bishuato. mishshum dehachi zammin lemebad lehu, dichtiv, (Micha 6:4) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot.

Veraza da hachi hu, kegavvna dehacha lel velayla, kach zammin kudesha berich hu lemebad lehu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 21:11) shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel. ma lehallan shemira velel, uf kan shemira velel. ma lehallan shemira velayla, uf kan shemira velayla.

Velayla itkere agav dechura, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 21:12) ata boker vegam layla. boker: kema deat amer (Bereshit 19:27) vayyashkem avraham babboker. dehu middato mammash. uchetiv (Tehillim Adonai:4) Adonai boker tishma koli, boker mammash.
Yatvu Rabbi chiyyay 206 yose, veolif lehu raza detorat kohanim, vahavu mehaddere bechol yoma veyatve kameh. chad yoma nafak rabbi shimon levar, azlu bahadeh, matu lechad chakla yatvu.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, ta chaze, ketiv, (Kohelet 7:15) et hakkol raiti bime hevli yesh tzaddik oved betzidko veyesh rasha maarich beraato, shelomo dahavat chachmeta yetera (nusach acher yakkira) al kolla, may kaamar behay kera. ella, shelomo remez dechachmeta ka ramaz. deha chazenan orchoy dekudesha berich hu delav hachi, deha ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:10) velatet leish kidrachav vekifri maalalav. ella tere inyayne ninhu, deka ramaz hacha.

Detanenan, kad enoy dekudesha berich hu baan leashgacha bealma, uleayyna beh, kema dichtiv (sefer acher ene Adonai hemma meshottot bechol haaretz 0 uchetiv ki vegomer) (divrei hayamim 2 16:9) ki Adonai enav meshottot bechol haaretz, veashkechan chayyayvin bealma, hahu tzaddika deishtechach bedara, ittefas bechovayyhu. vechayyayvayya maarich kudesha berich hu rugezeh immehon ad dituvun. vei lav, la yishtekach man deyitba rachame alehon, hada hu dichtiv, yesh tzaddik oved betzidko, mishshum dehahu zakkaa, istallak mealma.

Begine kach tanenan, leolam al yadur adam ella bimkom sheanshe maase darim betocho. may taama. mishshum devavy lehay demadoreh ben chayyayvayya, dehu ittefas bechovayyhu, vei dioreh ben zakkain, otivin leh beginehon.

Deha rav chasda, hava dioreh bekadmita bene kapputekae, vahava dechika leh shaata, umarin radfin avatroy. natal veshavve madoreh ben mare terisin detzippori, vesalik, vezacha lechamma tavin, lechamma utera, lechamma orayyta, veamar, kol hay zachena, al dealit ben innun dekudesha berich hu ashgach leotava lehu.

Davar acher, et hakkol raiti bime hevli. vechi shelomo, dedargin illain dechachmeta havo beh, al kol bene dara dichtiv (Melachim 1 Adonai:11) vayyechkam mikkol haadam, (vaashatedalevateyh beorayyta lemebad tivu ukeshot) dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:23) vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech, amar bime hevli. uchetiv, (Kohelet 1:2) havel havalim amar kohelet.
Vetana, 7 shemot nikra: shelomo. yedidya, agur. bin yake, itiel, lemoel. kohelet. kohelet keneged kullam. vechullam nikra
575: Keen shel mala, kohelet kenufeya kaddisha deve asara, begin kach kahal en pachut measara. vekahal afillu mea, vekohelet kelala decholla, kema deat amer (Devarim 33:4) kehilat yaakov.

Vetana, shemotav al shem hachachma itkerun, uvegin kach 3 sifrin aved, shir hashshirim. kohelet. mishle. vechullehu leashlema chachmeta. shir hashshirim lokovel dechesed. kohelet lokovel dedina. mishle lokovel derachame. begin leashlema chachmeta, vehu aved kol ma deavad begin leachazaa chachmeta, velokovel darga (nusach acher velokovel deraza) illaa, vehu amar bime hevli havel havalim.

Ella, raza dehevel yakkira hu. vehu hevel denafik mippuma, veraza dehevel denafik mippuma, kala itavid mineh. vetana, en haolam mitkayyem ella behevel pihem shel tinokot shel bet rabban shello chatu. shello chatu mammash. vehevel itavid berucha umayya, vechol ma deitavid bealma behevel itavid. veraza dehay hevel shel tinokot itavid kala, veitpashshat bealma, veinnun neture alma, uneture karta, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 127:1) im Adonai lo yishmar ir vegomer.

Veta chaze, hu hevel, hu kala. ma ben hay lehay. hevel (hu 131) kaim bechela, lemefak kala. kala mammash kaim bekiyyome (dela) leappaka (achara) milla. vehahu hevel dehava achasanteh daavoy karyeh hevel, uminneh chaza kol ma dechaza. veaf al gav desiyyuin saggiin meella acharanin havo leh, uleishtemoda milla, amar bime hevli. demilla da mittamman ata.

Veraza demilla hakkol, havel et hakkol raiti bime hevli, yesh tzaddik oved betzidko, da hu raza demilla, degalle ufarsem, decholla talya bime hevli, kelomar bezimna dehay hevel yanka min dina, begin lemebad dina, tzaddik oved betzidko, uvezimna dehay hevel yanka merachame. rasha maarich beraato. vetarvavyyhu talyayn behay hevel, uvegin kach ketiv bime, vela ketiv beyom. vecholla talyayn bime hevel da. man deara bedina, bedina. man deara berachame, berachame.

Vei tema yesh tzaddik oved vela kaamar avud. hachi hu oved mammash. dehahu dina oved latztzaddik mealma umiddara. veyesh rasha maarich beraato, maarich mammash, dehahu dina (sefer acher hevel) kad yanka merachame, avid rachame lehahu rasha, umaarich leh.

Ad dahavo yatve chamu kitora dehava salik leella venachit letatta. amar itattaruta itattar betinata (nusach acher baanayvatea) deara, miggo leella. addehachi, salik hahu chakla recha, mikkol busemin, amar netiv hacha, dishchinta gabban itkeyaym. begin kach, kereach sade asher beracho Adonai.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 27:27) vayyarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu vayyomer ree reach beni vegomer, vayyarach et reach begadav, mashma deinnun levushin havo sallekin recha tava, (sefer acher dela itade) ulevatar itade minnehon hahu recha. hasheta it leistakkela, ketiv, reach begadav, uchetiv reach beni, vela amar reach habbegadim, ella reach beni. ella tana, kevan shennichnas yaakov, nichnas immo gan eden. vetana, otan habbegadim hayu shel adam harishon, dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:21) vayyaash Adonai elohim leadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem, vehotziam miggan eden.

Vei tema, dichtiv vayyitperu ale teena deinnun havo, i hachi, amay ketiv vayyaash Adonai elohim. uchetiv katnot or, ha la havo ella ale teena ella ketargumo, levushin dikar vahavu sallekin rechin mibbusema deeden.

Vetanya, beshem male itavidu, dichtiv vayyaash Adonai elohim. ma dela itavidu beh shemayya veara. vela. veha ketiv, (Bereshit 2:4) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. la kashya hay kad itavidu, la itavidu beshem male, bar kad itkayymu, beshem male itkayymu.

Uma deamru deinnun levushin atu lehahu rasha deesav, denasiv lo min nimrod hachi okimna, vekashya milla, dei hachi ha ketiv leadam uleishto, levushin leadam, ulevushin lechavva. levushin dechavva ma itavidu. vetu, dei hachi
576: Bemay itkevaru, salleka datach deinnun shavku veramu minnehon zohara illaa, deyahiv lon kudesha berich hu.

Ella innun levushin deitlebashu behu adam veitteteh, la itlavash behu bar nash achara, divinnun levushin damu kegavvna dilella vei salleka datach, deinnun itlabbashu miggarmehon behu. ta chaze, ketiv vayyalbishem, dekudesha berich hu albish lon, zakkaa chulakehon.

Ketiv. (Tehillim 104:1) Adonai elohay gadalta meod hod vehadar lavashta. uchetiv (Tehillim 96:6) hod vehadar lefanav. uchetiv (Tehillim 104:2) ote or kassalma vegomer. kevan deitlabbash (45 deitlebash) aved ma deavad. melammed, shennitattaf kudesha berich hu beor, uvara yat shemayya. ella bemay okimna hachamudot asher itta babbayit. hachamudot: bigde malchut (58 73) bemeshi vezahav, vearcha dealma deganze lon bevusemin verichin, likara dilvushehon.

Ta chaze vayyarach et reach begadav, battechilla. vechad argish, amar ree reach beni, deyada deveh hava talya milleta, divgineh salik recha. kereach sade asher beracho Adonai, vechi mennayin hava yada yitzchak riach sade asher beracho Adonai.

Ella, teren millin innun, vecholla hu chad. dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot arev. vechi la hava leh beta, o makom acher lehitpallel. ella otah hassade haya asher kana avraham samuch lammeara, dichtiv, (Bereshit 23:20) hassade asher kana avraham meet beni chet. uveshaata dehava yitzchak al gabbeh, chama shechinta aleh, vesalik rechin illain kaddishin, uvegine kach hava metzalle tamman, ukevaeh litzloteh.
Veavraham amay la hava metzalle tamman, mishshum dikviuta deatra achara hava leh bekadmita, umilla achara recha dechama behar hammoriyya. velamma nikra moriyya. al shem hammor hattov dehava tamman.

Vecholla hava, vegan eden deal immeh uvarcheh. uvegin kach la tala milla bilvushin, ella beyaakov mammash, dechama deveh hava talya milla (sefer acher 6 ot hava laataberakeh) veitchazze, uzechuteh salik leitbarcha, veal immeh gan eden. uvegin kach kad itraam esav, amar gam baruch yihye. (milla)

Amar ribbi yitzchak, la itzterich orayyta lemichtav ella mehachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim. may taama. mishshum desheruta desihara have, veal da orayyta hava itzterich lemichtav mehacha, deha bekudesha berich hu itkashshar milla.

Vela kashya, dela ketiv zot, hachodesh hazzot, deha ze vezot kechad mitkashsherin uvaatar deit beh dechar venukeba kachada, let shevacha ella lidchura, veal da rishon hu lachem lechadshe hashshana, lechadshe hashshana vadday. amar ribbi yehuda, lachem tere zimne lamma. amar ribbi yitzchak, minnayyhu, ishtema yattir, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo. itkesharuta da lachem, vela lishar ammin.

(Shemot 12:3) dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se vegomer, beasor, amay beasor. amar ribbi abba, bezimna deanhir yovla lesihara, dichtiv beyovla, beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu.

Veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot, amay, begin divzimna da itzterich lemegad leh. deha tanenan, bemilleta da ittevar kitra (chada) tattaa, (70 amud bet) demitachadin beh kol shear kitrin tattain, veal da parish moshe veamar, mishchu ukechu lachem tzon, kema dichtiv, tzon veeved veshifcha.
Amar kudesha berich hu, avidu attun ovada letatta, vaana ittevar tukfehon leella, uchema detabedun benura attun, dichtiv ki im tzeli esh, ana uf hachi avir oto baesh binhar dinur.

Amay itnegid baasara, veitnechis bearbaa asar. amar ribbi abba beda itkashsharu yisrael arba mea shenin. veaf al gav dearba mea shenin la ishtaavidu behu, mikkol makom, hoil vahava zammin leitkashshera behu, itchashiv aleh keillu ishtaavidu behu kol 400 shenin. begin kach, meakkevin leh arba yomin, ketira birshutayyhu deyisrael, ulevatar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim.
Amay ben haarbayim. beshaata dedina talya, uveshaata deittemsar
577: Milla da leh, al yedoy deavraham, dichtiv (Bereshit 15:12) vayhi hashshemesh lavo vetardema nafla al avram vehinne ema chashecha gedola nofelet alav. ema: kitra chada. chashecha: kitra achara. gedola: hay dehi ravreva mikkolla. veaf al gav deokimna kera da al shear shibudayyhu deyisrael, vecholla hava. kegavvna da, (Shemot 17:14) ki macho emche, attun mittatta, vaana meella.

Tana, la nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, ad deittebaru kullehu shiltonin dilella (mashelashevaleyhevan) mishshuletanihon, venafku yisrael mershutehon, veaolu lirshuta kaddisha illaa bekudesha berich hu, veitkatiru beh, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:55) ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem. may taama avaday hem. asher hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim, deappakit lehu mershuta achara, veaalit lon birshuti.

Vehayeynu deamar ribbi shimon, may dichtiv, ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem ki kol ochel machmetzet. ana hachi okimna, hay seor, vehay machmetzet, darga chad innun, vechullehu chad. reshu ochare, innun shaltanin, dimmanan al shear ammin, vekarenan lehu yetzer hara, reshuta achara, el nechar, elohim acherim. uf hachi, seor, umachmetzet, vechametz, vecholla chad. amar kudesha berich hu, kol hane shane, kayymitu birshuta achara, avdin leam achara, mikkan ulehala deattun beni chorin, ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem. kol machmetzet lo tochelu. velo yerae lecha chametz.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi kol yeme shatta name, amay shivat yomin, dichtiv shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem, shivat yamim, vela yattir. amar leh, kol zimna deitchayyayv bar nash leitchazaa garmeh ben chorin, hachi itzterich, kol zimna dela itchayyayv la itzterich.

Lemalka deavad lechad bar nash rufinus, kol innun yomin desalik lehay darga, chadde, velavish levushe yekar, levatar la itzterich. leshatta achara natir innun yomin desalik leyakiru da, velavash innun levushin, vechen kol shatta veshatta kehay gavvna yisrael, ketiv, shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze, deinnun yome chedvavta, yomin desaliku likara da, venafku mishshibuda achara. uvegin kach, natrin bechol shatta veshatta, yomin desaliku lehay yekar, venafku mershuta achara, vealu birshuta kaddisha, veal da ketiv, shivat yamim matztzot tochelu.

Amar ribbi shimon, matztzat ketiv, kema deat amer, (Yechezkel 1:1) marot elohim. velamma itkere matztzat. dina. (223 2) dina kaddisha. dina deitachada bishma kaddisha. dina dela hava takkifa kol hahu zimna begavavyyhu deyisrael, deha kayyeyma sihara bifgimuta. veal dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, (Devarim 16:3) lechem oni ketiv.

May tama kayyeyma bifgimuta. begin dela itperau, vela itgalya hay at kaddisha. gezirin havo vela itperau, ematay itperau, beshaata dichtiv, (Shemot 15:25) sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu, veaf al gav deokimna hay kera bemilla achara, kolla hava veyeot.

Vei tema devime yehoshua itperau. lav hachi, ella innun dichtiv, (Yehoshua Adonai:Adonai) vechol haam hayyillodim bammidbar badderech vegomer. batar deitperau, amar kudesha berich hu, bekadmita achaltun matztzot, dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, veikre lechem oni, mikkan ulehala hay lechem meatar achara leheve. may hu. dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. la min sihara kehahu zimna, ella min hashshamayim mammash, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:28) veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim.

Veyisrael kaddishin, natrin innun yomin dealu techot gadfoy dishchinta, venatrin hahu nahama deatya missitraha, veal da ketiv, (Shemot 23:15) et chag hammatzot tishmor vegomer, uchetiv ushemartem et hammatztzot. mahu ushemartem et hammatztzot. kema deat amer, (Shemot 19:5) ushemartem et beriti. vecholla bechad darga salleka veitachad.
Vei tema moshe hech la para lehu. ella, begin dela yitakkevun yisrael taman ad deyitsiu, veal da ketiv, (Devarim 16:3) shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni. may tama lechem
578: Oni, mishshum ki bechippazon yatzata vegomer uchetiv velo yachlu lehitmahmeah.

Ta chaze, kad alu yisrael leara, alu gezirin veitperau. uma ketiv, (Devarim 8:9) eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem. may vemiskenut. lechem oni. amay ikre lechem oni. mishshum dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, vela mitbarcha mishshimsha, vela mitnahara min shimsha, kema deat amer, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) ki chol bashamayim uvaaretz, vela itnahara (mikkol) miyyovla. may taama. mishshum dela itperau. aval hacha, deitgezaru yisrael veitperau, lo techsar kol bah ketiv, veal da lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem. may taama. mishshum dela techsar kol bah, kema dechasru leh bemitzrayim.

Uvechol shatta veshatta ducherana demitzrayim ka avde yisrael, veachle vela ishtetze middare darin. uvegin dela itperau hacha bemitzrayim, chasru leh lehay kol, vekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, veikre lechem oni, oni: ketargumo miskenut. umay deachlu leh tamman beara, begin ducherana demitzrayim hava, vehay ledare darin, ulezimna deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:20) lo yavo od shimshech virechech vegomer.

Tanna amar ribbi shimon ketiv beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 23:27) ach beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu, ishtema kema deittemar, dichtiv beasor lachodesh hazze. may ka mayyre. ella beasor, milla da beasor talya. lachodesh hazze bachodesh hazze mibbae leh. ella, kad ata nimusa lehay darga, ketiv lachodesh hazze dayka.

(Shemot 12:3) veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot se labbayit. tana telat kishrin innun, bechor behema, bechor hashshevi, bechor hashshifcha. (ditlat kishrin) dechol shear mitkashshere behu beillen telat gavvne dilella. uvehay deitkere tzon, itkashshar kolla, vecholla kalil batztzon, itkashshar tzon batztzon, vela yachil leitparsha mikkitroy, uvehay kullehu itkashsharu, veal da ketiv, vehaya lachem lemishmeret, ketiru leh biktiruta, viyhe itmesar bidechon birshutechon, ad detanchesu leh, vetabedun beh dina, ulezimna deate ketiv (yeshaya 63) mi ze ba meedom. uchetiv, (yeshaya la) ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra. uchetiv, (Zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Raya mehemna (Shemot 12:34) veyissa haam et betzeko terem yechmatz vegomer. 25 pikkuda da, levaer chametz. deha pikkuda da, itmesar lehu leyisrael veyissa haam et betzeko terem yechmatz. uchetiv seor lo yimmatze bevattechem, veha ukemuha chavrayya, veraza okimna, ben chametz umatztza dechamma duchete, da yetzer ra, veda yetzer tov.

26 Pikkuda batar da, lesapper bishvacha ditziat mitzrayim, deihu chiyyuva al bar nash, leishtae behay shevacha lealmin. hachi okimna, kol bar nash deishtae bitziat mitzrayim, uvehahu sippur chadde bechedva, zammin ihu lemechode bishchinta lealma deate dehu chedu mikkolla, dehay ihu bar nash dechadde bemareh, vekudesha berich hu chadde behahu sippur.

Beh shaata, kanish kudesha berich hu lechol pamalyay dileh, veamar lon, zilu ushemau sippura dishvacha dili, deka mishtau banay, vechaddan befurekani. keden kullehu mitkanneshin, veatyayn umitchabberin bahadayyhu deyisrael, ushemau sippura dishvacha, deka chaddan bechedva defurekana demarehon, keden atyayn veodan leh lekudesha berich hu, al kol innun nissin ugevuran veodan leh al amma kaddisha deit leh beara, dechaddan bechedva defurekana demarihon.

Keden ittosaf leh chela ugevureta leella, veyisrael behahu sippura yahave chela lemarehon, kemalka, deittosaf chela ugevureta, kad meshabbechin gevureteh, veodan leh, vechullehu dachalin mikameh, veistallak yekareh al kullehu. uvegin kach, it leshabbecha uleishtae besippur da
579: Kema deittemar. kegavvna da, chova ihu al bar nash, leishtee tadir kame kudesha berich hu, ulefarsume nisa bechol innun nissin deavad.

Vei tema, amay ihu chovata, veha kudesha berich hu yada kolla, kol ma dehava, veyehve levatar dena, amay pirsuma da kameh, al ma deihu avad, veihu yada. ella vadday itzterich bar nash lefarsume nisa, uleishtae kameh bechol ma deihu avad, begin deinnun millin sallekin, vechol pamalya dilella mitkanneshin, vechaman lon, veodan kullehu lekudesha berich hu, veistallak yekareh alayyhu ella vetatta.

Kegavvna da, man deishtae umefaret chetoy al kol ma deavad, i tema lemay itzterich. ella mekatrega kaim tadir kame kudesha berich hu, begin leishtee ulemitba chove bene nasha, ulemitba alehon dina. kevan deakdim bar nash, umefaret chetoy, kol chad vechad, la ashir pitra defuma lehahu mekatrega, vela yachil lemitba aleh dina. deha tadir tava dina bekadmita, ulevatar mishtae umekatreg peloni aved kach. veal da, itzterich leh levar nash leakdema, ulefaret chetoy.

Kevan dimkatrega chame da, let leh pitra defuma aleh, ucheden itperash mineh mikkol vachol. i tav betiuveta yeot, vei lav, ha mekatrega ishtechach aleh, veamar peloni deata lekamach betukefa deappin, bait bemareh, chovoy kach vechach. al da yeot leizdahara bar nash bechol hane, begin deyishtechach avda mehemana kame kudesha berich hu.

27 Pikkuda batar da, leechol matztza befesach, begin deihu ducherana ledare darin, al raza dimhemnuta. veha ukemuha, deyisrael nafku behahu zimna meraza detaavavn acharan, vealu beraza dimhemanuta. veha ukemuha raza dena bechamma duchete.

(Shemot 12:43) vayyomer Adonai el moshe veaharon zot chukkat happasach vegomer. 28 pikkuda da, lemishchat pesach ben haarbayim, beyd benisan, ducherana dehahu pesach demitzrayim. veda ihu chovata al kolla, kema deat amer, veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim.

Pesach da, itzterich lemehve natir, measara yomin ulehala, dichtiv beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem vegomer. may taama. begin deha keden shariat sihara leanhara, measara yomin ulehala, ad deishtelim bachamesar. vearbesar delehevi nachis, beshaata dedina talya al alma.

Raza da, leabera zuhama, mikkame berit kaddisha, uleithanaa behahu recha denadif tevi nur. veal da la atya ella al sava. veal da, vechol arel lo yochal bo. man deit beh berit kaddisha, yechul beh. man dela it beh berit kaddisha, la yechul beh. dehay mibbene berit ihu letavra tukepa dechela achara, leabera arla mikkame berit. begin kach, hay bivne berit ihu lemebad, vela bivne arla.

Kad ata kudesha berich hu lemitzrayim, chama dama dehahu pesach, dehava rashim al pitcha, vedama divrit, hech havo kayymin al pitcha, dichtiv, ulekachtem aguddat ezov utevaltem baddam asher bassaf vehiggatem vegomer. ezova, ha okimna deihu mabar ruchin (22 amud bet) bishin, vechol setar ruach bisha, mabar beitaruta dileh, befurekana illaa deyisrael.
Lezimna deate, yete kudesha berich hu leyetzer hara veyikkos leh. vehasheta befurekana da, ketiv veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael vegomer. ducherana dezimna deate, behahu purekana illaa.

Al shete hammezuzot veal hammashkof behay reshimu deat yod, uvehay reshimu deat yod, leachazaa reshimu divrit kaddisha, veittebar arla mikkame dama divrit, rashim al kolla, veata dama al dama. kad avar hahu mashchit, hava chame dama, veizdekif mibbeta, kema deat amer velo yitten hammashchit vegomer.
I kudesha berich hu bilchodoy katil, amay ketiv velo yitten hammashchit, demashma demashchit hava azil vela kudesha berich hu. ella vadday kudesha berich hu hava katil, umashchit hava azil
580: Leashkecha ila leyisrael, kevan dehava chame hahu teviru dearla, bitren sitrin, hava arak veitperash minnayyhu.

Veal dekatal kudesha berich hu kol innun bucherin dehahu sitra, yahiv bucherin deyisrael lefurekana, dela yishkach alayyhu sitra achara ila kelal, uvecholla natir lon leyisrael kudesha berich hu, keabba al benin.

(Shemot 12:46) bevayit echad yeachel lo totzi min habbayit vegomer, (ayyen lekamman sof parashat pinchas) pikkuda 29 da, lemechal hay pesach. al matztzot umerorin, matztzot matztzat ketiv. may hay lokovel hay, ella leachazaa galuta dishchinta immehon deyisrael, behahu meriru dilhon, dichtiv vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha vegomer. vechad achlin lehay pesach, leachazaa kol hay deavdu lon bemitzrayim, behahu galuta uvehahu shibuda.

Ma ketiv veetzem lo tishberu vo, leachazaa beh kelana, uvechol innun taavavn demitzrae. deha garmin havo raman beshuka, veatu kalbe vahavu garre lon meatar laatar, veda kashya lon mikkolla, deha garme innun tikkuna degufa, vedami legavvna achara, veyisrael raman lon beshuka orach kelana, veal da ketiv veetzem lo tishberu vo, attun la tishberun, aval kalbe havo atyayn umetabberin leh.

Tu, mitzrae havo atyayn levatar, vahavu chaman innun garme dahavo natle kalbe meatar laatar, umadkan lon, vahavu mitzrae tamni lon go afra, begin kalbe dela yishkechun lon, veda ihu bittula deavodat kochavim umazzalot, yattir, missitra dilhon. uveda kudesha berich hu istelak bikareh, veitkafyayn kol chelin acharanin, deha keden itkafyayn yattir, kad batilu ishtechach missitra dilhon, veal da yisrael la mevattele lon, dichtiv veetzem lo tishberu vo.

(Shemot 13:15) kaddesh li chol bechor peter rechem vegomer. pikkuda da lekaddesh bechor behema, veam haaretz tzarich teren milin, chad dihe paduy mittechot shultanuta deyetzer hara, deihi adon dileh, kegavvna deamar yaakov leesav, (Bereshit 33:14) yaavar na adoni lifne avdo. behay alma. adon mitztzad chovin dinfishin al gufa, kema deukemuha, chayyayva, yetzer hara shofto. zakkaa, yetzer hattov shofto. benoni ze veze shofto. benoni, hayeynu ach deyetzer hara, veach deyetzer hattov, achi yehi lecha asher lach.

Vechad zachvavn nefishin, rucha tavar teren mishmarot, dachamor noer, chelavim tzoakim, vesalik lemishmeret deshachar, deveh adam veithaddar bar nash adon, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:6) vayhi li shor vachamor tzon veeved veshifcha, vesalik ledarga deadam, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 1:28) uredu bidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim vegomer, (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem vegomer.

Vechad zachvavn benoniyyim, (Bereshit 32:25) vayyeavek ish immo, zachvavn vechovin mitchabbekan leaggacha kerava. missitra dezachvavn, (Bereshit 32:26) vayyar ki lo yachol lo. missitra dechovin, vayyigga bechaf yerecho begid hannashe. nashe: lashon (Bereshit 41:51) ki nashshani elohim et kol amali veihu leshon neshiyya. chad madora meinnun shiva aran, man denachit taman itnneshe mineh orayyta.
