Vekodem deyete bar nash behay alma veyippuk merechem imeh, vayyeavek ish immo, da gavriel, behahu avak deafar, deittemar (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama, veolif leh shivim lashon. uvegin da, vayyitzer: chad yetzer hattov, deolif leh shivim lashon. vechad, yetzer hara deavik immeh. deittemar, ki naga bechaf yerech yaakov begid hannashe, veashkach mineh shivin lashon, deolif leh yetzer hattov.

Vekodem kol da, nachtin immeh arbea malachin, deittemar behon (Tehillim 91:11) ki malachav yetzavve lach. i it leh zechut avot, chad michael, bizchut avraham. vetinyayna gavriel, bizchut yitzchak. utelitaa denachit immeh nuriel, bizchuta deyaakov. ureviaa refael, bizchuta deadam kadmaa. veyetzer hattov leella minneh.

Vei let leh zechut, azle immeh 4, avon, mashchit, af, vechema, veyetzer hara leella minayyhu, lemedan leh lealma deate. uvegin da ukemuha, rasha, yetzer hara shofto. tzaddik, yetzer hattov shofto. benoni, ze veze shofto. uvegin da, i ihu benoni, gavriel deihu yetzer hattov,
581: Vesamael deihu yetzer hara, ze veze shofto.

Dilchol bar nash deit beh arba yesodin, arba malachim nachtin immeh mimina, vearba missemala. arba mimina: michael, gavriel, refael, nuriel. vearba missemala: avon, mashchit, af, vechema. missitra degufa, metatron nachit aleh mimina, vesamael missemala.

Velet bar nash delet beh arba yesodin, aval kefum yesoda deakdim beh, hachi matchilin illen arba. i mazzal dileh arye, akdim michael, vaavatreh gavriel vaavatreh nuriel, vaavatre refael. vei mazzaleh shor, akdim gavriel, vaavatreh michael, vaavatreh nuriel, vaavatreh refael. vei mazzaleh nesher, akdim nuriel, vaavatreh michael, vaavatreh gavriel, vaavatreh refael. vei mazzaleh adam. akdim refael, vaavatreh michael, vaavatreh gavriel, vaavatreh nuriel.

Veinnun missitra dimina, missitra demichael, kullehu anpin dileh, innun rachame, baal gemilut chasadim, anpoy chivvavrin, vehay bar nash gamil chesed. chasid, vechacham, i ishtaddal beorayyta. vei lav, behippuch, missitra deyetzer hara, gazlan, tippesh, let beh chesed. dela am haaretz chasid.

Missitra degavriel, arba anpin dileh dina, middat haddin al rashiayya, umitgare behu, kema deukemuha, muttar lehitgarot barshaim baolam hazze. gibbor beyitzreh, yere chet, dayyayn yehe, i yitassek beorayyta, vegibbor betalmudeh. behippucha missitra deyetzer hara, mitgare betzaddikayya, dina kashe lon, gibbor baavera, lemebad leh, lav dachil chattaa hu, ugevavnin deanpoy sumakin, esav shofech damim.
Man demazzaleh nesher, lav rachaman saggi, velav middat haddin saggi, ella benoni, beyetzer tov bemiddot tavin dileh, uvenoni beyetzer ra bemiddot bishin, veleh anpin chivvavrin vesumakin.

Man demazzaleh adam, missitra detov, kalil mikkol middot tovot, chasid, vechacham, vegibbor battora, yere chet, memulla bechol middot tavin, ugevavn anpoy ukkamin. umissitra deyetzer hara, memulla mikkol middot bishin.
Vei chovoy devar nash, nefishin shaltin aleh kol mashiryayn deyetzer hara, ad deyistelaku mineh kullehu mashiryayn deyetzer tov, veamlich al evarin dileh, samael vechol mashshiryayteh.

Vei nefishin zachvoy, shaltin mashiryayn deyetzer hattov, ad deyistelaku minneh kol mashiryayn deyetzer hara. veamlich al kol evarin dileh, mashiryayn deyetzer hattov, behahu zimna, shalit aleh shem Adonai.

Veim hu benoni, tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav mimino umissemolo, illen mayyminim lizchut, veillen masmeilim lechova, uman dealim gavar. uvegin da ukemuha mare matnitin, leolam yirae adam atzmo keillu kol haolam kullo taluy bo.

Umissitra demichael, itkere bechor, dedargeh kesef chivvavru, uvegin da, pidyon habbechor kesef, Adonai selaim, kechusheban Adonai deavraham, dei yachkim battora yittosaf aleh 10, deihu kodesh, deveh tzarich lekaddesh bechor behema, dehayynu (yirmeya 2) kodesh yisrael laAdonai. uveh tzarich leasser veladot, dechol valad ihu missitra deven 15, veihu 6.

Dechol chevan deinnun chevat hakkodesh, beatvavn dishma kaddisha itkeriu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:7) kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ. afillu kol biryayn deitberiu behon, velet beria dela itreshim behay shema, begin leishtemoda leman dibbera leh, vehay yod, ihu diyyukena deresha dechol biryayn. Adonai Adonai: diyyukena de etzbeaan dimina, vaAdonai dismala. 6 diyyukena degufa.

Uvegin da amar, (Yeshayahu 40:25) veel mi tedammeyuni veeshve yomar kadosh. let bechol beriyya deeshve kevavti, veaf al gav devarati lah kidmut atvavn dili, daana yachil lemachaa hahi tzura, ulemebad lah kamma zimnin, velet eloah achara alay deyachil lemimche
582: Diyyukeni uvegin da (Devarim 32:31) ki lo chetzurenu tzuram veoyvenu pelilim.

Vei yikshe bar nash, deha ketiv (Devarim 4:15) ki lo reitem kol temuna. ihu yetaretz leh, hay temuna chazena, deha ketiv (Bamidbar 12:8) utemunat Adonai yabbit. velo vechol temuna achara (sefer acher devara veyetzer beatvoy), debar nash deyatzar beatvoy uvegin da amar, (Yeshayahu 40:18) veel mi tedammeyuni veeshve veel mi tedammeyun el uma demut taarchu lo.

Vaafillu hay temuna, let leh beatreh, ella kad nachit leamlecha al biryayn, veyitpashshat alayyhu, yitchaze lon lechol chad, kefum mare vechezyon vedimyon dilhon, vehay ihu (Hoshea 12:11) uveyad hanneviim adamme.

Uvegin da yema ihu, af al gav daana adamme lechu bediyyukenayychu, el mi tedammeyuni veeshve, deha kodem debara kudesha berich hu diyyukena bealma, vetziyyer tzura, hava hu yechiday belo tzura vedimyon, uman (nusach acher veit) deishtemoda leh, kodem beria, deihu levar middiukena, asur lemebad leh tzura udeyukena bealma, lo beot Adonai, velo beot 10 vaafillu bishma kaddisha, velo beshum ot unekuda bealma, vehay ihu ki lo reitem kol temuna, mikkol davar deit beh temuna vedimyon lo reitem.

Aval batar deavad hay diyyukena demerkava deadam illaa, nachit taman, veitkere behahu diyyukena Adonai, begin deyishtemudeun leh bemiddot dileh, bechol midda umidda, vekara: el, elohim, shadday, tzevaot, 19. begin deyishtemudeun leh, bechol midda umidda, ech yitnaheg alma, bechesed uvedina, kefum ovadehon divne nasha, dei la yitpashshat nehoreh al kol biryayn, ech yishtemodun leh, veech yitkayyem, (Yeshayahu 6:3) melo chol haaretz kevodo.

Vavy leh, man deyashve leh, leshum midda, vaafillu meillen middot dileh, kol shekken livne haadam, (Iyov 4:19) asher beafar yesodam, dechalim venifsadim. ella dimyona dileh, kefum shaltanuteh al hahi midda, vaafillu al kol biryayn. uleella mehahi midda. vechad istelik minah, let leh midda, velo dimyon, velo tzura.

Kegavvna deyamma, delet bemayya deyamma denafke minneh, tefisu kelal velo tzura, ella deitpashshatuta demayya deyamma al mana, deihu ara, itavid dimyon, veyachilna lemebad chusheban taman, kegon hammakor deyamma ha chad. nafik minneh mayan, kefum itpashshatuta dileh mehahu mana, keiggula deihi 10, ha makor chad, umayan denafik mineh ha teren.

Levatar aved mana ravreva kegon man deavad (nusach acher dechafer) chafira ravreva veitmele min mayya, denafik min mayayn. hahi mana itkere yam, vehu mana telitaa, vehahu mana ravreva, veitpelig lez nechalin, (nusach acher manin) kefum manin arichin, hachi itpashat mayya min yamma, leshiva nechalin veha makor, umayayn, veyamma, vez nechalin, innun 10 vei yetabbar umana illen manin detakkin, yehadderun mayya lemakor, veyishtaaru manin tevirin yeveshin belo mayya.

Hachi illat haillot, avid eser sefirot, vekara lecheter makor, uveh let sof linviu dinhoreh. uvegin da kara legarmeh en sof, velet leh demut vetzura, vetamman let mana lemitpas leh, leminda beh yedia kelal. uvegin da amru beh, bammufela mimmecha al tidrosh, uvamchuse mimmecha al tachkor.

Levatar aved mana zeera, veda 10, veitmalya minneh, vekara leh mayan novea chachma, vekara garmeh bah chacham, ulehahu mana kara leh chachma. ulevatar aved mana ravreva, vekara leh yam, vekara leh bina, vehu kara legarmeh mevin bah.

Chacham meatzmo, umevin meatzmo, ki chachma ihi la itkeriat chachma miggarmah, ella begin hahu chacham deamle lah minneviu dileh. veihi la itkeriat bina miggarmah, ella al shem (nusach acher begin) hahu mevin deamle lah minneh. dei hava mistallak minah, ishtaarat yevesha. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 14:11) azlu mayim minni yam venahar yechorav veyavesh.

Levatar vehikkahu leshiva nechalim. veavid leh lez manin yakkirin, vekara lon: gedula. gevura. tiferet. netzach. hod. yesod. malchut. vekara garmeh gadol baggedula vechasid. gibbor, baggevura. mefoar, battiferet. mare natzchan keravin, benetzach netzachim. uvehod kara shemeh, hod yotzrenu. uvaysod kara shemeh tzaddik. visod, kolla samich beh, kol manin vechol almin.
583: Uvemalchut, kara shemeh melech. velo haggedulla vehaggevura vehattiferet vehannetzach vehahod ki chol bashshamayim, deihu tzaddik. velo hammamlacha: deihu malchut.
Kolla birshuteh, lemechosar bemanin, uleosafa behon neviu, ulemechesar kefum reuteh (sefer acher behon) velet aleh elaha, deyosif beh, o yigra beh.

Levatar aved meshammeshin, leillen manin, kurseyay bearba samchin. veshit dargin lechurseyay. ha eser. vecholla ihu kurseyay. kegon kos divracha, detakinu vo asara devarim, begin tora deityeyhivat baasara dibberan. begin alma deihu maase bereshit, deitbere baasara maamarot.

Vetakin lechurseyay kittot leshammesha leh, deinnun malachim. erelim serafim. chayyot. ofannim. chashmallim. elim. elohim. bene elhim. ishim. uleillen avid shammashin, samael, vechol kittot dileh, deinnun kaananim lemerkav behon lenachta beara, veinnun kesusin lon.

Umenalan daananim ikrun merkav. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 19:1) hinne Adonai rochev al av kal uva mitzrayim. veda memana demitzrayim, umiyyad dechazu (memana) deelaha di hu elaha memana dilhon, chazu leh kesuseya, techot merkavteh dekudesha berich hu, miyyad venau elile mitzrayim mippanav, ulevav mitzrayim yimmas, nau meemuna dilhon, velev dilhon names kaddonag, mehahi emuna, veamri, vechi ad kean emuna memana dilan kesuseya, hava na libbehon meemuna dilhon, venames kaddonag. umenalan deyimas leshon names kaddonag ihu kema deat amer, (Tehillim 22:15) haya libbi kaddonag names betoch meay.

(Vayikra 20 amud alef) (Shemot 13:13) vechol peter chamor tifde vese vegomer. (pikkuda lehavi karev vechulei) pikkuda da lifdot peter chamor, velaarof peter chamor, im lo yifde leh. hada hu dichtiv veim lo tifde vaarafto. veraza da yetzer hara, yachol leachzera betiyyuveta, (sefer acher ulevatar yetzer hattov vechulei) ulevatar leachzera yetzer hattov, kema deukemuha, im zacha ezer, im lo zacha kenegdo. begin deinnun diyyukena, chad dese, vechad dachamor, vei zacha leachzera betiyyuveta, af al gav deihu chamor am haaretz, tifde min galuta vese, deihu (Yirmeyahu 50:17) se fezura yisrael. vei la hadar betiyyuveta, vaarafto, shave leh am keshe kedal, daatidin leitmachaa min sefer chayyim, dealayyhu ittemar, (Shemot 32:33) mi asher chata li emchennu missifri.

(Shemot 13:16) vehaya leot al yadcha uletotafot ben enecha vegomer (behar 108 amud bet uvammishna) (8) pikkuda da, pikkuda deikre begavvna achara, dela ikre mitzva, ella kedusha, veillen innun tefilin. tefilla shel yad, utefilla shel rosh. tikkuna peera shappiru digvavnin illain. veal da ikrun totafot, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Uchetiv (Hoshea 11:1) ki naar yisrael vaohavehu, yisrael zuta. shema yisrael, yisrael sava, shappiru digvavnin, ella vetatta. yosef salik veitattar bitren gavvnin (nusach acher dargin) bekadmita naar, uvesofa tzaddik. kamma yaan beh gavvnin lemechoze, veraza da (Bereshit 39:6) vayhi yosef yefe toar vife mare. shappira bitren sitrin, bitren dargin, bitren gavvnin, ella vetatta.

Ketiv (Devarim 6:18) veasita hayyashar vehattov. hayyashar: da tefilla shel yad, leamshacha (sefer acher laasamekaa) leh bitfilin shel rosh, leityachada kachada. utefilla shel yad, akdim leshel rosh. veitzterich dela have piruda benayyhu kelal.

Man demitatra bitfilin, kaim beraza degavvna illaa vekaim beinnun teren razin dekamran keyosef, deikre naar, veikre tzaddik, beraza deeved neeman, beraza deven yechiday. veillen innun tefilla shel yad, utefilla shel rosh, veinnun kelala chada bela piruda.

Arba parshiyayn ditfilin bed battim, beinnun tefilin shel rosh. uchema deinnun 4 parshiyayn beinnun tefilin shel rosh, uf hachi kullehu bitfilin shel yad bevayit 1. deha battefila shel yad, let lah miggarmah kelum, ella ma denakta milleella. veraza da, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam. umiggo denakta lon milleella, ikre tefilla, veitkaddeshat bikdushathon (vecholla) ikre kedusha. veikre tefilla ucheden ikre malchut, malchut shamayim shelema.
4 Parshiyayn, ha okimna raza dilhon, bechamma duchete. aval parasha kadmaa, kaddesh li chol bechor, da ihu raza
584: Illaa, dechalil kol 4 battim, beraza dinhiru illaa, denafka meayin.

Vechol innun 4 itremizu hacha, kaddesh: da kedusha illaa. raza dechachmeta illaa, demittamman kolla itkaddash, beraza deganizu illaa, deitkere kaddesh. li: da bina, raza dealma illaa, hechla penimaa. (veraza da 0 ki li bene yisrael avadim 1 ki li kol bechor 2 vihyitem li segulla) chol: raza dechesed, bechol ducheta, ben leella ben letatta. bechor: da ben bechor, dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael, vehay ben bechor, kalil kol sitrin, vechol gavvnin. uvegin kach, kera kalil kullehu arba, beraza dechachmeta illaa. aval da beorach kelal, leminda decholla kalil behay, aval beorach perat, kol chad bilchodoy, da ihu parsheta kadmaa, dechalil kol shear parshiyayn.

Parasha tinyayna, vehaya ki yeviacha vegomer, da bina, deha befarsheta da, ihi yetziat mitzrayim, dehava missitra deyovla. veal da sheruta dilah vehaya, deha milla da ihi beyovla. uvegin kach shema dilah vehaya, delet vehaya (nusach acher havaya) ella baatar da, deihu zammin leitmashshecha letatta, uleanhara butzinin, uleishtakkecha bedarga tattaa, (nusach acher vehaya keman deamar al malka deihi have) (nusach acher deyeheve zammin leitmashshecha letatta uleanhara butzinin) vecholla beraza chada. uvegin deihu beorach tamir, la ikre beitgalleyay bishma da, ella itmesar lechakkimin leminda. veal da itreshim bishma kaddisha, bemilla da.

Parasha telitaa, shema, da ihu raza dimina, deikre chesed illaa. deihu ka meyayched yichuda decholla led sitrin, vekudesha berich hu mesadder beh, siddura dechol alma, veda ihu deka mitpashshat bechol sitrin, afillu go tehome tattae. beda kudesha berich hu bara alma, kad itattaf kudesha berich hu beittufa dezihara, veda deka meyayched yichuda, uvegin kach, shema samich livhaya.

Yichuda dechol yoma, ihu, yichuda leminda uleshavvaa reuta. yichuda da ha amaran bechamma duchete, yichuda dechol yoma, ihu yichuda dikra, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai ha kullehu chad, veal da ikre echad. ha telat shemahan innun, hech innun chad, veaf al gav dekarenan echad, hech innun chad.

Ella, bechezyona deruach kudsha ityeyda, veinnun bechezu deena setima, leminda ditlata illen echad. veda ihu raza dekol deishtema, kol ihu chad, veihu telata gavvnin, eshsha verucha umayya, vechullehu chad, beraza dekol. (velav inun ella chad) uf hacha: Adonai elohenu Adonai innun chad. telata gavvnin, veinnun chad.

Veda ihu kol deavid bar nash beyichuda, uleshavvava reuteh beyichuda decholla, meen sof ad sofa decholla, behay kol deka avid behane telata deinnun chad. veda ihu yichuda dechol yoma, deitgele beraza deruach kudesha.

Vechamma gavvnin deyichuda itaru, vechullehu keshot. man deavid hay avid. uman deavid hay avid. aval hay yichuda deka anan mitare mittatta, beraza dekol deihu chad, da hu berira demilla, hay bichlala, levatar perat, kidkaamran.
Parasha reviaa, hu raza dedina kashya, (Devarim 11:16) hishshamru lachem. illen innun tefilin deresha. utefillin didroa, kegavvna da bechad beta, veha ittearna behu, vechullehu raza chada.
Kishra ditfilin derisha, ihu dalet, veal da ketiv, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray. veal da ihu laachora, vetamman itkashshar kolla bekishra chada.

Veihi, kad manchat illen tefilin didroa leitkashshera, (sefer acher it kishra) achara, raza divrit kaddisha, raza da, kema deittear bechamma duchete, vecholla raza chada. zakkain innun yisrael deyadin raza da, veitzterich bar nash laanacha lon kol yoma, lemeheve bediyyukena illaa, vealeh ketiv, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyyaru mimmekka. 585: Vayhi beshallach paro et haam velo nacham elohim derech eretz pelishtim vegomer. ribbi shimon patach, (Chavakuk 3:1) tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi al shigyonot. hay kera kashya, veit leistakkela beh, may shena tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi, yattir mikkol shear nevie alma, dela ketiv behu tefilla lishaya hannavi, o leyirmiyya, o lichezkel, o lehoshea, o lishar nevie alma.

Ella hachi tanenan, elisha zacha behay alma ma dela zacha nevia ochora, bar mimmoshe. (veim kol da lo baa leatrecha lemareh) ta chazi, may ketiv, (Melachim 2 4:8) vayhi hayyom vayyaavor elisha el shunem vesham ishsha gedola. may ishsha gedola. ella gedola beovadaha, dechol bene (sefer acher dara) beta, mishtabbechin bah, vehi ikara deveta, uvegin devaalah la hava shechiach beveta, lemeheve ikara, la hava idkar hu, ella hi.

Vetu, vesham ishsha gedola: gedola al kol shear neshe alma, deha shear neshe alma, kad chaman ushepiza beveta, mitztaaran beh, vedachakan beh kol shekken leappaka aleh mamona, vehi chadat beh beushepiza, uleappaka aleh mamona, kol shekken kevan dechamat leh leelisha chadat beh lachadda. veal da, shevacha decholla deitteta hi, deha ushepiza deveta deitteta hi. uvegin kach vesham ishsha gedola, gedola al shear nashin.
Vattomer el ishah hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu, bemma yada. ella ha ukemuha chavrayya, deshushifa chivvavra zerikat leh bearseh. vela chamat beh keri meolam, vela abar zevuva befatoreh.

Hane mile kashyayn, i tema dela chamat beh keri, ha saggiin innun bene nasha hachi bealma, ma shinnuya hacha. vei tema dela avar zevuva befatoreh. amay ketiv, hinne na yadati, vechi hi yadat, vela ochora, veha kol innun dechamu leh achil befatoreh havo yade.

Ella shappir kaamrat, aval hinni na yadati, hi yada, vela ochora, begin dehi metaknat arseh, beshaata deshachiv belelya, uveshaata dekaim betzafra. vehay dekamre deshushifa chivvavra zerikat leh bearseh, hachi hava, uvah yada, dearcha dealma, kevan dekaim bar nash mearseh, salik shushifa denaim bah, recha menuvala. vehay, beshaata desalkat hahu shushifa mearseh, hava salik rechin, (127) kerechin deginta deeden. amra i lav dekaddisha hu, ukedusha demareh aleh, la salik recha kaddisha hachi.

Begine kach, bae leitparsha min beta, dela izdehar bar nash kol kach beveta. aval amrat, (Melachim 2 4:10) naase na aliyyayt kir ketanna venasim lo sham mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora, arba illen lamma. ella begin deinnun tikkuna dichneset yisrael, deitkeriat aliyyayt kir, vehachi itkary, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyya panav el hakkir.

Mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora, lav innun ketikun deshimmusha, deha kisse ka bae bekadmita, ulevatar shulchan, levatar menora, levatar mitta, amay akdimat mitta. begin dehi chaviva aleh yattir mikkolla, veakdim bar nash ma dechaviv aleh.

(Melachim 2 4:10-11) vayhi hayyom vayyavo shamma. vayhi hayyom, man hu yoma da. ella kema deukemuha. veta chaze. hahu yoma, yoma tava derosh hashshana hava, deitpekadu beh akarot dealma, veitpakkedan beh bene alma. kara lashshunammit veamar, (Melachim 2 4:13) hinne charadt elenu et kol hacharada hazzot. begine kach, itzterichna leayyeyna yoma da bedini dealma, dekudesha berich hu dain beyoma da
586: Lealma, uvegin deitparashna bilchod baatar da, itzterichna leistakkela birgizu dealma.

(Melachim 2 4:13) uma laasot lach hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech o el sar hatztzava. vechi milla da lema itztericha legabbe itteta, dela nafkat vela azlat vela alat behechla demalka. ella, yoma da hava garim, dechol bene alma yatvin (nusach acher kayymin) bedina, uvehahu yoma ikre kudesha berich hu melech. hammelech hammishpat. amar lah, i at itzterich lach legabbe malka illaa, al ovadin di bidach.

Vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet. may kaamrat. ella beshaata (nusach acher bezimna) dedina talya bealma, la yitperash bar nash bilchodoy, vela yitreshim leella, vela yishtemodun beh bilchodoy, deha bezimna (achara) dedina talya bealma, innun deishtemodun ureshimin bilchodayyhu, af al gav dezakkain innun, innun ittafsan bekadmita. veal da, la livae leh leinish, leitparsha mibben amma lealam, divchol zimna rachame dekudesha berich hu al amma kullehu kechad. (velo livae leh leinish laataperash min amma lealam) uvegine kach amra, betoch ammi anochi yoshavet, vela beena leitparsha minnayyhu, kema deavedna ad yoma den.

Vayyomer gechazi aval ben en lah vegomer. amar lah elisha. ha vadday shaata kayyeyma, deha yoma garim. vayyomer lammoed hazze kaet chayya at choveket ben. vattahar haishsha vatteled ben lammoed hazze kaet chayya asher dibber eleha elisha. lammoed vadday. levatar mit. may taama mit. ella begin deityeyhiv lah, vela levalah. umeatar denukeba itkashshar, uman deitkashshar benukeba, mota izdammenat kameh. mena lan delah ityehiv, dichtiv at choveket ben.

Ta chaze, beavraham ketiv (Bereshit 18:10) shov ashuv elecha, velo eleha, elecha vadday, bach itkashshar, vela benukeva. man deate missitra denukeba, mota akdim leragloy. vattaal vattashkivehu al mittat ish haelohim, begin detamman chamat kedusha illaa mikkolla.
Vayyomer lah hashalom lach hashalom leishech hashalom layyaled. mikkan, dehi ikara deveta, velo od ella deihi azlat avatreh, velo balah. vayyiggash gechazi lehadfah ha ukemuha.

Vayyomer ish haelohim harepe lah. may shena hacha deamar ish haelohim, vechad hava bemata elisha. ella hacha vadday ish haelohim, dehacha (sefer acher hu) chaza ducheteh, vela bemata, vela beshaata dahavo beni nevie kameh.

VaAdonai helim mimmenni vegomer, kema deat amer (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora, da be dina diltatta. velo higgid li, may taama lo yada elisha. ella amar kudesha berich hu, uma ana katil lehay, i ema leh, lo yamut, deha nevizbeza dileh hu. vadday it leh lememat, deha ittemar, dichtiv at choveket ben, umeatar denukeba garim mota, uvegine kach la amar leh.

Vayyomer legechazi chagor matnecha vekach mishanti veyadcha valech. veha ukemuha veistelak nisa minneh. chay Adonai veche nafshecha im eezvekka, amay kevan degechazi hava azil. ella hi yadat archoy dehahu rasha degechazi, delav ihu keday deyishtechach nisa al yedoy.

Vayyasem piv al piv veenav al enav vegomer. amay, ella deashgach elisha veyada deatra (deitteta hu) da hu degarim, deitkeshar beh hasheta. vayyasem piv al piv veenav al enav, lekashshera leh beatra ochora illaa, atar dechayyin ishtechachu beh.

Vela yachil leakera leh meatar deitkashshar beh bekadmita, ella ittear rucha chada milleella, veitkeshar behay atar, veativ leh nafsheh. dei lav hachi la hava kaim lealmin. vayzorer hannaar ad sheva peamim, vela salik yattir, kema deat amer (Tehillim 90:10) yeme shenotenu bahem shivim shana.
Veda hu chavakkuk nevia, kema deat amer at choveket ben. i hachi chavuk mibbae leh, amay chavakkuk tere. ella, chad
587: Deimmeh, vechad deelisha, deitchabbak immeh. davar acher tere chibbukin havo beh, ben lehay sitra ben lehay sitra. chibbuka chada, hahu atar dehava tale beh bekadmita. chibbuka acharina desalik leh ledargin illain yattir, uvegin kach chavakkuk tere.

(Chavakuk 3:1) tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi, may tefilla. ella da hu atar, dehava kashir beh bekadmita, veda hu tefilla shel yad. al shigyonot. dehahu yoma deitkeshar beh, shigyonot dealma havo talyayn kame kudesha berich hu, ugevura hava shalit, veal da itkeshar beh hay tefilla. (nusach acher behay tefilla)

Davar acher tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi, tefilla lachavakkuk: begin chavakkuk, deihu avid begineh. Adonai shamati shimacha yareti vegomer, ta chaze, kad hava ittear aleh rucha dinvua al atar da dehu tefilla, hava ate vahava dachil umizdazi. matla amri, man denashich mikkalba, mikkaleh izdaza.

Adonai paalcha bekerev shanim chayyehu, man paalcha. ella, aleh kaamar, deihu poal dileh. bekerev shanim chayyehu. hav leh chayyin lehay paalcha, bekerev shenin illain. davar acher, chayyehu dela yamut kad bekadmita.

Al shigyonot, may al shigyonot, al shegiot mibbae leh. kema deat amer (Tehillim 19:13) shegiot mi yavin. ella (kolla hu aval) shigyonot, kema deat amer (Tehillim 7:1) shiggayon ledavid. zini tushebchan havo kamayyhu dinvie, lemishre alayyhu ruach nevua, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 10:Adonai) ufagata chevel neviim yordim mehabbama velifnehem nevel vetof vegomer, uchetiv (Melachim 2 3:15) veatta kechu li menaggen vegomer. vechol shekken chavakkuk, deitzterich leh yattir mikkullehon, lenayycha derucha, ulevassema lehahu atar, leamshacha aleh ruach nevua. vechen kullehu nevie kehay gavvna, bar mimmoshe desalik al kol shear nevie dealma, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, ruchehon hava tavir begavvavyyhu, vahavu shamin innun tushebchan, vela yachlin lemechode, uveshaata dechullehu ochlosin uretichin nafku bishchinta, kullehu arimu tushebchan veshirin kame kudesha berich hu, veittear kudesha berich hu ruchehon deyisrael, vahavu shamin innun tushebchan, vekaim ruchehon begavavyyhu dela parchan.

Bar nash kad ihu shavik pulechana, keden yada teviru degarmoy, teviru derucheh. kach yisrael, kad nafku mimmitzrayim, keden taimu taama demota, vekudesha berich hu asse lon, dichtiv, (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam vegomer. vechol orchin, havo sallekin rechin deasvata, vealin legufayyhu veittasyayn, vekal tushebchan dahavo shamin, havo chaddan venayychin beruchehon.

Ufaro vechol innun uchelosin dileh, havo azle batrayyhu, leozfa lon, ad denafku meara demitzrayim. vechen kol innun ravrevin dimmanan alehon, veal shear ammin, ozifu lah lishchinta uleyisrael kullehu, ad desharu beetam biktze hammidbar, hada hu dichtiv, vayhi beshallach paro et haam vegomer. ki karov hu, ki karov hu. hahu omaa deome avimelech laavahan, al hahu tivu deavdu pelishtim laavahan, dichtiv (Bereshit 21:23) kachesed asher asiti immecha taase immadi veim haaretz asher garta bah.

Vayhi beshallach paro et haam, ma ketiv leella, vayyakam paro layla hu vechol avadav. ta chaze, nukema illaa deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim. telat motani havo. chad, deavdu bucherin bemitzrayim, dekatilu kol innun deashkachu. vechad, dekatal kudesha berich hu befalgut lelya. vechad, kad chama paro motana beveteh bivnoy uveavdoy, kam vezariz garmeh, vekatil afarchin vesarchin, vechol deamlichu leh lesarva beamma ad deorayyta ashidat aleh deihu kam belelya mammash. kema (dekudesha berich hu befalgut) delelya katal bucherin veavid nukemin, hachi kam paro beara demitzrayim, vekatal veavid nukemin besarchoy, veafarchoy, vaamarkeloy, uvechol innun ravrevin
588: Hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 12:30) vayyakam paro (layla mammash), dekam lekatala uleshetzaa.

Orchoy dechalba, kad machyayn leh beavna, ihu ate venashich lechavreh, kach paro, levatar ihu hava azil bashshevake, vahava machriz veamar, kumu tzeu mittoch ammi, attun kataltun lechol beni mata, attun kataltun sarche veafarche vechol bene beti, hada hu dichtiv vayyikra lemoshe uleaharon layla. kevan devidchon hava kolla, uverachtem gam oti, dela tiktelun li. levatar ihu begarmeh ozif lon, veappik lon meara, hada hu dichtiv vayhi beshallach paro et haam vegomer.

(Shemot 13:18) vayyassev elohim et haam derech hammidbar yam suf letakkena archa leatreh. Rabbi yehuda amar, may shena kad havo yisrael bemitzrayim, dichtiv, (Shemot Adonai:1) shallach et ammi, (Shemot 9:2) ki im maen atta leshalleach et ammi, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael, uvehahu zimna la havo gezirin, vela itkashsharu beh kedka yeot. vehacha dahavo gezirin, veavdu pischa, veitkashsharu beh, kare lon et haam.

Ella begin hahu erev rav, deitdevaku behu, veitarvu bahadayyhu, kare lon et haam setam. kema deat amer, (Shemot lak) vayyiggof Adonai et haam al asher asu et haegel. vayyikkahel haam al aharon. vayyar haam ki voshesh moshe. vechen kullehu.

Rabbi yitzchak 206 yehuda havo azle meusha lelud, vahava immehon yose tayyaya, biktira degammale atufira bechatfayyhu. ad dahavo azle, ashkach hahu yose tayyaya intu chada dishar ammin, dekatir biroke chakla, ishtemit minnayyhu veatkif bah, veata alla. tavvhu Rabbi yitzchak 206 yehuda, amru netuv mearcha da, deha kudesha berich hu baa leachzaa lan, dela nitchabbar bahadeh. tavu mearcha, badku batreh, veashkachu divreh devat el nichar hava, vaavuha pasil zara hava. amru, berich rachamana desheziv lan.

Patach Rabbi yitzchak veamar (Tehillim 37:1) al titchar bammereim. man innun mereim, dela ketiv chattaim, o reshaim. ella meriim, deavishin legarmayyhu, ulehani demitchabberan bahadayyhu. Rabbi yehuda amar, mereim: archek garmach mimmereim dela tehvon reim vachaverim kachada, dela yavishu lach ovadoy, vetitpas bechetoy.

Ta chaze, i la havo innun erev rav deitchabberu behon yisrael, la itavid hahu ovada, vela mitu miyyisrael, kol innun demitu, vela garim lon leyisrael kol ma degarim. veta chaze, hahu ovada, vehahu chova mammash, garim galutehon deyisrael.

Detanenan, baa kudesha berich hu, deyishtakkechun yisrael behahu shaata kemalache illae, ulemebad lon cherin mikkolla, cherin mimmota, ulemeheve cherin min shibuda dishar ammin, kema deat amer, (Shemot 32:16) charut al halluchot, al tikre charut, ella cherut.

Kevan deitavid hahu ovada, garimu kolla. garimu mota, garimu shibud malkevavn, garimu deittebaru innun luche kadmae, garimu demitu miyyisrael, kamma alfin minnayyhu. vechol da, begin itchabberuta deinnun erev rav, deitchabberu behu.

Uf hacha, beginehon, la itkerun beni yisrael, vela yisrael, vela ammi, ella haam setam. vei tema vachamushim alu bene yisrael. kad havo sallekin mimmitzrayim, vela itchabberu bahadayyhu innun erev rav, kare lon bene yisrael, kevan deitchabberu bahadayyhu, dichtiv vegam erev rav ala ittam, kare lon haam.

Ribbi yose akshe veamar, ketiv ki asher reitem et mitzrayim hayyom lo tosifu lirotam od ad olam. i hachi, kol yoma havo chaman lehahu erev rav. amar ribbi yehuda, erev rav ketiv, velo mitzrayim, deha kamma shear ammin havo dayyeyre bemitzrayim. velo od ella dechullehu itgezaru, vechevan deitgezaru, la ikrun mitzrae.
Veal puma demoshe kabbilu lon. vehayeynu ma
589: Deamar hakkatuv, (Shemot 32:8) lech red ki shichet ammecha saru maher min hadderech asher tzivvitim. tzivvitam ketiv. vachamushim alu beni yisrael meeretz mitzrayim, chad mechamishsha havo. ver yose omer chamishsha miyyisrael, vechad minnayyhu. ribbi yehuda omer, vachamushim: echad mechamishshim.

Amar rabbi shimon, begin (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet) dehahu yovla salik lon mimmitzrayim, begin kach vachamushim alu bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim. vei lav, la seliku, veal da itakkevu chamshin yomin lekabbela orayyta. umehahu atar nafkat orayyta, veityehivat, veal da vachamushim chaser. divgin da alu bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim.

(Shemot 13:19) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef vegomer. amay salik garmoy. ella, begin dehava resha lenachta legaluta. velo od, ella deihu simana digula hava leh veume lehu leyisrael al da, hada hu dichtiv ki hashebea hishbia et bene yisrael, veha ittemar.

Zakkaa chulaka demoshe, deyisrael havo aske lemishal mamona mimmitzrae, umoshe hava asik beumaa deyosef. veit deamre arona benilus hava, uvishma kaddisha salik leh, veod amar moshe, yosef, higia zeman purekana deyisrael, veamar ale shor. vesalik. veit deamre, ben malche mitzrae hava, umittamman salik (sefer acher leh). veit deamre, begin dela yaavdun leh avoda zara, shavo benilus veserach bat asher chavviat leh lemoshe.

(Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 22:1) lamnatztzeach al ayyelet hashshachar mizmor ledavid. kamma chaviva orayyta kameh dekudesha berich hu, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, rachim hu leella, rachim hu letatta, kudesha berich hu atzit leh lemiluloy, la shavik leh behay alma vela shavik leh bealma deate.

Veorayyta bae lemile bah bimama uvelelya, dichtiv, (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam valayla. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla vegomer. tinach bimama, belelya amay. begin diyhe shechiach legabbe shema kaddisha shelim. kema delet yomam bela lelya, velav ihu shelim, ella da im da, kach bae orayyta, leishtakkecha immeh debar nash yoma velelya, lemeheve shelemuta legabbe debar nash yomam valayla.

Veha ittemar, deikara delelya, mippalguta veilach. veaf al gav defalgu kadmita bichlala delelya hu, aval befalgut lelya, kudesha berich hu al beginta deeden, leishtashea im tzaddikayya, ucheden, bae leh levar nash lemekam, ulemile beorayyta.

Veha ittemar, dekudesha berich hu vechol tzaddikayya divginta deeden, kullehu tzayytin lekalleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini, veha ukemuha, hayyoshevet baggannim: da keneset yisrael, deihi meshabbachat leh lekudesha berich hu, bishvacha deorayyta, belelya. zakkaa chulakeh, man deishtattaf bahadah, leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, bishvacha deorayyta.

Vechad ate tzafra, keneset yisrael atya umishtashea beh bekudesha berich hu, veoshit lah legabbah sharvita dechesed, vela alla bilchodaha, ella alla, veal innun demishtattefin bahadah, veha ittemar dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla vegomer. veal da ayyelet hashshachar ikre.

Veamar rabbi shimon, beshaata devae leitnahara tzafra, itchashach veitkaddar nehora, vekadruta ishtechach. keden itchabberat itteta bevalah, detanenan, ishsha mesapperet im balah, lemishtae bahadeh, vealat lehechleh.

Levatar kad bae shimsha lemeal, itnehir veatat lelya, venatil leh. keden kol tarin setimin, vechamrin naarin, vechalbin navchin, kad itpelag lelya, shaari malka (lemikre) lemekam, umatronita lezammera, veate malka veakish letara dehechla, veamar (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti rayati vegomer. ucheden mishtaasha benishmathon detzaddikayya.

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu, deittear hahu zimna bemille deorayyta, begin da, kol innun divne hechla dematronita, kullehu bayayn lemekam behahu zimna, leshabbecha lemalka vechullehu meshabbechan kameh, ushevacha desalik mehay alma, da deihu rachik, (yattir) da nicha leh lekudesha berich hu mikkolla.
Kad istelik lelya, veate tzafra, (nusach acher vaaytechasheych) veitkaddar, keden malka umatronita beraza bechedva, veyahiv lah mattenan, ulechol bene hechlah. zakkaa chulakeh man deihu beminyayna.
VaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. kudesha berich hu, uvet dineh.
590: Amar ribbi yitzchak, hayeynu detanenan, shechinta baavahata natla. holech lifnehem yomam: da avraham. beammud anan: da yitzchak. lanchotam hadderech: da yaakov. dichtiv beh (Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halach ledarko. velayla beammud esh lehair lahem: da david malka.

Vechullehu reticha illaa kaddisha, lemehach yisrael bishlimuta decholla, begin deyechozun avahan purekana (sefer acher devenayyhu) dilhon, dichtiv, (Bereshit 46:4) veanochi aalcha gam alo, im hammerkava. uchetiv vaAdonai holech vegomer, lalechet yomam velayla. vechi amay havo azle yomam velayla, yahachun bimama, vela yahachun belelya, kivni enasha dearkin, kevan dekudesha berich hu natir lon, amay azlin bimama uvelelya. ella, leishtakkecha behu shelemuta decholla, delet shelimu ella yom velayla.

Amar ribbi abba, hachi okimna, vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan: da avraham. velayla beammud esh: da yitzchak. vei hachi yaakov an hu. ella bemilla kadmaa ittemar, vetamman shaari, kema dichtiv vaAdonai.

Velayla beammud esh, hava nahir, besitra da uveda. begin deyirdefun mitzrae batrehon, leityaykra shema dekudesha berich hu, birtichoy ufarashoy. begin lemezal yemama velelya, aspakalarya denahara, udela nahara. vetu, begin leataa lemitzrae deyemrun mikre hu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 19:13) noalu sare tzoan, uchetiv (yeshaya ma) meshiv chachamim achor, veal da azle bimama uvelelya.

Ribbi abba amar, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu appik lon mimmitzrayim, lemeheve chulakeh veachasanteh. veta chaze, besitra deyovla, ishtechach cheru leyisrael. vechen lezimna deate, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 27:13) vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol vegomer.

Uvegin hahu yovla illaa, itakkevu chamshin yomin, lekabbela orayyta, ulemikrav letura desinay. vechevan deazle biymama, azle belelya, lemehve kolla chad yoma, ben yemama velelya, vela ishtechach perishu.

Velo od, ella dechullehu benayycha azlin, liruta denafshayyhu, beyoma dekabbilu orayyta, havo chamshin yomin shelemin, yome velele kedka yeot, delet yom belo layla, velet layla belo yom, velayla veyom ikre yom echad. vechevan deazlu chamshin yomin shelemin, keden (lekabbel 50 deyovla vechamma) sharu alayyhu innun 50 yomin deyovla, umissitra deyovla ityeyhiv lehu orayyta, uvegin kach azlin yoma velelya.

Veamar ribbi abba, ketiv (Bereshit 27:1) vayhi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav, amay. ha okimna, man derachim lachayyayva, hachi hu. veta chaze, beyitzchak itkelil lelya, velelya lo bahir, veal da vattichhena enav, vecholla chad.

Rabbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Shemot 14:5) vayyuggad lemelech mitzrayim ki barach haam, vayyuggad, man kaamar leh. ella, ha ukemuha. aval chachmoy vecharshoy itkenashu legabbeh, veoduhu ki barach haam. vaamay kamru da. ella chamu bechachmeta dilhon, dahavo azle yemama velelya, amru vadday arkin innun. velo od ella dechamu dela havo azle beorach meshar, kema dichtiv veyyashuvu veyyachanu lifne pi hachirot.

(Shemot 14:7) vayyikkach shesh meot vegomer. shesh meot amay. amar ribbi yose, lokovel minyayna deyisrael, dichtiv keshesh meot elef ragli. bachur: lokovel haggevarim deinnun ikara dechol yisrael. vechol rechev mitzrayim: shear retichin, deinnun tefalin laachore, (nusach acher laacharenayn) lokovel hattaf dichtiv levad mittaf. vecholla avid beeta decharshoy vechachmoy. veshalishim al kullo, kolla bechachmeta, lokovel dargin illain, teren vechad. Rabbi yitzchak amar, ketargumo, umezarzin. zerizin havo becholla.

Vayyikkach shesh meot rechev bachur. Rabbi chiyyay amar, ketiv (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom veal malche haadama al haadama. bezimna dekudesha berich hu yahiv shultanuta leravreve ammin leella, yahiv lehu leamma dilhon letatta. uveshaata denachit lon middargehon dilella, nachit lon leamma letatta, vayyikkach shesh meot rechev bachur, ha memana dilhon, veukemuha, dedavar retichin dishar ammin, vechullehu naflu bemashrita desisra levatar vehayeynu bachur (nusach acher ulevatar) vechol rechev mitzrayim.
Ketiv (Shir HaShirim 1:9) lesusati berichve faro dimmitich rayati. ta chaze, kedugemat suseya nukeba, itchaze lehon lesusehon defaro, veukemuha. ella lesussati berichve faro,
591: Ta chaze, paro beshaata dehava radif avatrayyhu deyisrael, ma aved, natal susevavn nukevan, vechafat lon birtichoy bekadmita, vesusin ducherae kafat lon laachorehon, vahavu mezayyeynin duchere lokovel nukeve, venukeve la baan, veochan lemezal. kevan dekariv (nusach acher vechad adbek) legabbayyhu deyisrael, natal nukeve veshavve lon laachore, vesusevavn ducherin lekadmin, leavasha leyisrael, uleaggacha behu kerava.
Kegavvna da, vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam, uvatar chazra shechinta laachorehon deyisrael, dichtiv vayyissa malach haelohim vegomer. begine kach dimmitich rayati.
(Shemot 14:10) ufaro hikriv, vehay kera ha ukemuha. deakriv lechol cheloy uretichoy, leaggacha kerava. vetu ufaro hikriv. ribbi yose amar, ha ittemar dekariv lon litshuva. ufaro hikriv.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 26:16) Adonai batztzar pekaducha tzakun lachash vegomer. batztzar pekaducha: la pakdin yisrael lekudesha berich hu, beshaata denayycha, ella beshaata deakin lehu, ucheden kullehu pakdin leh. tzakun lachash: vechullehu tzallan bitzlotin uvevautin, veariku kameh tzelotin. ematay. (Yeshayahu 26:16) musarcha lamo, beshaata defakid lon kudesha berich hu birtzuoy. keden kudesha berich hu kaim alayyhu berachame, venicha kameh hahu kala dilhon, begin leitpara min sanehon, veitmele alayyhu berachame.

Kema deokimna, metal leyona im hannitz vechulei, kach yisrael havo kerivin leyamma, vahavu chaman leyamma kamayyhu, azil vesair vegalgallohi zakfin leella, havo dechilin. zakfu enayyhu vechamu lefaro ulemashiryayteh, veavne girin uvallisterain, keden vayyiru meod. ma avdu, vayyitzaku bene yisrael man garim hay dekarivu yisrael legabbe avuhon dilella, paro. hada hu dichtiv ufaro hikriv veha ittemar.

(Shemot 14:13) vayyomer moshe el haam al tirau hityatztzevu ureu et yeshuat Adonai. amar ribbi shimon zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deha raya kemmoshe azil begavvavyyhu. ketiv (Yeshayahu 63:11) vayyizkor yeme olam moshe ammo. vayyizkor yeme olam: da kudesha berich hu. moshe ammo (mikkan shelli hu) shakil hava moshe kechol yisrael. veolifna meha, ki raya deamma hu mammash amma kullehu, i ihu zache, amma kullehu zachan. vei ihu la zache, amma kullehu la zachan veitanashu begineh, veha ukemuha.

Hityatztzevu ureu, let lechu leaggacha kerava, deha kudesha berich hu, yaggiach kerava beginechon, kema deat amer, Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. ta chaze, hahu lelya, kanash kudesha berich hu lepamalya dileh, vedain dinayyhu deyisrael, veilmale deakdimu avahan alayyhu deyisrael, la ishtezivu min dina. ribbi yehuda amar, zechuta deyaakov aggin alayyhu deyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 124:1) lule Adonai shehaya lanu yomar na yisrael, yisrael sava.

(Shemot 14:14) Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. ribbi abba patach (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itrae behon, leitdabbeka behu, mikkol shear ammin dealma, umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kariv lon legabbeh, veyahav lon orayyta, veyahav lon shabbat, deihu kaddisha mikkol shear yomin, venayycha mikkolla, vechedva decholla, veshakil shabbat, lokovel orayyta kella, uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Vekarata lashshabbat oneg, innuga decholla, innuga denafsha vegufa innuga deillain vetattain. vekarata lashshabbat, may vekarata. deyazmin leh. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh, kelomar, zeminin, kema dimzammin ushepiza leveteh. veal da vekarata lashshabbat oneg, deyazmin leh, kema dimzamnin ushepiza, befatora metakkena, beveta metakkena kedka yeot, bemechla uvemishteya kedka yeot, yattir al shear yomin. vekarata lashshabbat mibbeod yom. (emor 22 amud alef) likdosh Adonai mechubbad: da yom kippurim. tere deinnun chad. vechibbadto measot
592: Mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, veha ittemar, begin dehahi milla salleka, veittear milla dechol leella. man dimzammin ushepiza, beh bae leishtaddela, vela baochora.

Ta chaziyi hahu milla denafik mippumeh devar nash, salleka veittear itaruta leella, i letav, i levish. uman deyativ beinnuga deshabbeta, asir leh leitteara milla (43 2) dechol, deha pagim pegimu beyoma kaddisha. man deyativ behillula demalka, la yitchaze lemishbak lemalka, veyitassek beachara.
Uvechol yoma bae leachazaa ovada, uleitara ataruta mimma deitzterich. uveshabbat, bemille dishmayya, uvikdushsha deyoma bae leitteara, vela bemilla achara.

Ta chaze, hacha kad itkeriv paro leaggacha kerava behu beyisrael, behahi zimna, la bae kudesha berich hu, deyittearun yisrael itaruta letatta kelal, deha itaruta leella hu, deha avahan akdimu veattearu itaruta da leella, uzechuta dilhon kaim kameh, (veattearu itaruta da) vela baa kudesha berich hu deyisrael yittearun letatta kelal. (deha beatrah leella hava) hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. tacharishun vadday, vela titarun milla, dela itzterich lechu, vehacha itkelil shema kaddisha beatvavn reshiman, veha itaru beh chavrayyay.

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda havo azle bearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda, vadday tannina, Adonai, bechol atar rachame, veaf al gav deaggach kerava, veavid dina, hahu dina birchimuta hu. vehacha chamena, dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem, vela itchaze behahu dina rachame kelal, deha ketiv lo nishar bahem ad echad.

Amar leh, milla da shemana meribbi shimon deamar, deafillu hacha dina berachame hava, dechafa alehon yamma umitu, ulevatar appik lon yamma, vekudesha berich hu baa bikarehon, veitkevaru beara, vela baat ara lekabbela lon, ad deoshit lah kudesha berich hu yemineh, vekabbilat lon, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:12) natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. uvegin da, (hava) hay dina berachame hava.

Veal da, la baa kudesha berich hu deyittearun yisrael milla bealma, dei yitarun yisrael milla, la yitarun shema derachame, vela yitavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun, dela titarun midi. deha shema derachame bae leitteara alayyhu, lemebad dina berachame. veal da bae, dela taavdun pegimu, vetitarun milla achara.

Amar leh, veha ketiv, (Zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem. i hachi da dina berachame hava. amar leh, hachi hava vadday, dina hu berachame, demota dilhon la ishtechach kemotana dishar bene alma, ella chas alayyhu kudesha berich hu, dela yehon kemotana dishar bene alma, dekatilu lon, ella benachat belo tzaara, ha dina berachame ihu.

Uvechol atar, shema da, dina berachame ihu, bar atar chad, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze vegomer. vechi kagibbor velo gibbor. ella yeshanne levushoy, veyilbash levushin acharanin. keish milchamot, yeshanne zineh.

Veim kol da, dina hu yattir, aval rachame beh, kema dichtiv, kagibbor, velo gibbor. keish milchamot, velo ish milchamot. devadday af al gav deavid dina, chas al ovadoy, veal da, Adonai yillachem lachem vadday veattem tacharishun. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu barir lon lechulakeh veachasanteh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

(Shemot 14:15) vayyomer (178 amud bet) Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay. milla da ha ukemuha besifra ditzniuta, vetamman hu raza dileh, vayyomer Adonai el moshe. Rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Yona 2:2) vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga, ma ketiv leella, vayman Adonai dag gadol. vayman: kema deat amer (Daniel 1:Adonai) vayman lahem hammelech devar yom beyomo. asher minnah et maachalchem.
593: Mibbae leh, vayman Adonai et yona laddag, dehu mana hu dimshadder leh. ella vadday, hahu dag hu hava mana leyona, lenatra leh min shear nuni yamma, veyehve ganiz begavveh. vechevan deaaleh begavveh, chama yona bemeoy, puteya daatar yamma (nusach acher puteya daatar dameavey) kemo hechla ravreva, uteren enoy dehahu nuna, denaharin keshimsha, veeven tava hava bemeoy, denahir leh, vahava chame kol ma di beyamma uvithomoy.

Vei tema, i hachi, may dichtiv, (Yona 2:3) karati mitztzara li, ha la itchaze, dechol hay revavcha hava leh. ella vadday, kevan deachme leh hahu nuna, kol ma di beyamma uvithomoy, mit, dela yachil telat yomin lemisbal. keden akat leh leyona.

Deamar ribbi elazar, kevan dechama yona kol hahu revavcha, hava chadde. amar kudesha berich hu, uma tive yattir, leha ailna lach hacha. ma avad, katal lehahu nuna umit, vechol shear nune yamma, havo sachare sacharanih dehahu nuna, da nashich leh mehay gisa, veda nashich leh mehay gisa. keden chama yona garmoy beaku, miyyad vayyitpallel yona el Adonai.

Bekadmita dag, vehasheta daga. kema deat amer, (Shemot 7:21) vehaddaga asher bayor meta. ucheden ketiv, karati mitztzara li. vela ketiv hayiti batztzara, o yashavti batztzara, ella karati, mehahu aku deakin li nuni yamma. mibbeten sheol shivvati, deha mit. vela ketiv mibbeten chay, o mibbeten dag, ella devadday hava mit.

Kevan detzalle tzeloteh, kabbil leh kudesha berich hu, veachyeh leh lehay nuna, veappik leh leyabbeshta leenehon decholla. dichtiv, vayyomer Adonai laddag vayyake et yona. vechamu kullehu, avidta dekudesha berich hu.

Ma ketiv, vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga, laatar dehava kashir beh, mashma dichtiv Adonai elohav, vela ketiv vayyitpallel el Adonai vela yattir, ella Adonai elohav. uf hacha, vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay. elay dayyka.

Dabber el bene yisrael veyyisau. veyyisau milleasgaa millin, lav idana ditzlota hasheta. veyyisau, vechi lean atar pakid lon deyintelun, deha al yamma havo sharan. ella ahdar leella, dichtiv ma titzak elay, deha kullehu baatar da kayyme. veal da vayyisu, yintelun min da, delav idana hu.

(Sefer acher ella beattika talyay milleta) (Shemot 14:16) veatta harem et mattecha vegomer. harem et mattecha, di beh rashim shema kaddisha, arkin yedach besitra dishma kaddisha, vechevan diyechomun mayya shema kaddisha, yaarkun minneh. umikame (nusach acher kammeh) veal da, unete et yadcha, lesitra chada, desitrin acharanin dehahu matte, itzterich lach lemayyin (nusach acher leh lemillin) acharanin.

Amar ribbi elazar, chamena, dezimnin itkere hay matte, matte haelohim, ulezimnin itkere matte demoshe. amar Rabbi shimon (tere havo vehachi okimna) besifra derav hamenuna sava, shappir kaamar, dechullehu chad, ben tema dekudesha berich hu, uven tema demoshe, vehay mate, leatara sitra digvura. veal da, unete et yadcha, yeda dismala, deihu besitra digvura.

Amar ribbi shimon, vavy leinun dela chaman, vela mistakkelin beorayyta, veorayyta kare kamayyhu bechol yoma, (sefer acher velo yadin) vela mashgichin. ta chaze, besitra digvura mitare mayya bealma, venafke mayya, vehasheta bae kudesha berich hu lenagva mayya, amay unete et yadcha, deihu semala.

Ella harem et mattecha, lenagva mayya. unete et yadcha, leatava mayya, leatara sitra digvura, uleatava mayya al mitzrayim. uvegin kach, teren millin hacha, dichtiv harem et mattecha, unete et yadcha al hayyam uvekaehu.

Veha tehome havo. ella kudesha berich hu, aved nisa go nisa, kema deat amer (Shemot 15:8) kafu tehomot belev yam. vahava azlin beyabbeshta bego yamma, hada hu dichtiv vayyavou bene yisrael betoch hayyam bayyabbasha.
594: (Shemot 14:25) vayyasar et ofan markevotav. rabbi shimon patach, (Yechezkel 1:15) vaere hachayyot vehinne ofan echad baaretz etzel hachayyot. hay kera ukemuha veittemar, aval ta chaze, kudesha berich hu becholla itchaze shultanuta dileh, veshultaneh di la tade lealam ulealme almin.

Veavid shuletanuta baavahan, natal leavraham, vekiyyem beh alma, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, veukemuha. natil yitzchak, veshatil beh alma, deihu kayyaym lealmin, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:21) veet beriti akim et yitzchak. natal yaakov, veotveh kameh, veishtaasha bahadeh, veitpaar beh, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Veta chaze, yaakov achid beilana dechayye, delet beh mota lealmin, dechol chayyin behahu ilana ishtachlalu, veyahav chayyin lechol innun daachidan beh. uvegin kach, yaakov la mit. veematay mit, beshaata dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:33) vayyeesof raglav el hammitta. hammitta. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinne mittato shellishlomo, begin divhay mitta ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavt, uvegin kach vayyeesof raglav el hammitta ketiv, keden vayyigva vayyeasef el ammav. veavid kudesha berich hu leyaakov shelimu daavahan, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 41:8) yaakov asher becharticha.

Ta chaze, kol mashiryayn dilella, vechol innun retichin, kullehu achidan illen beillen, dargin bedargin, illen illain veillen tattain. vechevavta kaddisha alayyhu, vechullehu ochlosin umashiryayn, kullehu natlin techot yedaha, al memraha natlin, veal memraha sharan.

Veda hu chevata, (sefer acher ella kaddisha) dechol shear chevata, achidan bah veishtalshalu (sefer acher veishtachlalu) beginah kamma chevan lechevan (sefer acher illen sallekin veillen nachtin) veitachadan dargin bedargin, vechullehu illain vetattain azlin veshatin beyamma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) ze hayyam gadol urechav yadayim sham remes veen mispar vegomer.

Vechad salik yamma galgalloy, kullehu arbin sallekin nachtin, vezapa ishtechach, verucha takkifa azla aleh bitkifu. venune yamma mitbadderin lechol setar, illen lemizrach, veillen lemaarav, illen latztzafon, veillen laddarom. vechol innun beni alma, dechaman reshima alayyhu, natlin lon, uvalin lon bekaftiyiri afra.

Vechol arbin la natlin meatrayyhu, vela sallekin venachtin, bar mehahu shaata, deate chad dabbera beyamma, veyada leashlema rucha dezapa deyamma, kevan desalik da aleh deyamma, shachich merugeza, venayycha ishtechach, ucheden kullehu arbin azlin beorach meshar, vela satan limina usemala, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:26) sham oniyyot yehallechun livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo. ze dayyka. vechol nune yamma mitkanneshin leatrayyhu. vechol innun chevavn chaddan alah, vechevavn chakla illaa chaddan, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 40:20) vechol chayyat hassade yesachaku sham.
Ta chaze, kegavvna dilella, it letatta. kegavvna diltatta, it beyamma. kegavvna dilella, it leella beyamma illaa. kegavvna dilella it letatta. kegavvna diltatta, it beyamma tattaa.

Gufa dehahu yamma, ha itarna lechavrana, orcha ufuteya, resha uderoin vesaare gufa, kolla kema deitzterich, vecholla bishmeh (vaychi 245) itkere. uchegavvna da letatta leyamma diltatta, hachi name resha deyamma, uderoin deyamma, vegufa deyamma.

Ketiv (Bereshit 49:13) zevulun lechof yamim yishkon. veha yamma chad hava beadveh ella may lechof yamim, vadday ukemuha chavrayyay beraza illaa. veyarchato al tzidon, kema deat amer (Shemot 1:Adonai) yotze yerech yaakov. zevulun shoka dimina degufa hava, veyam kinneret hava beadveh, umehacha ishtechach chillazon litchelta.

Ta chaze, kamma retichin al retichin ishtechachu, vegalgalloy dirticha rahatin bivhilu, vela mitakkeve innun samche reticha, lenatla alehon. vechen kullehu. (nusach acher vehacha shennahagu bichvedut bivhilu) ta chaze, reticha di memana al mitzrae, (i tema) ukemuha, reticha shelemata la ishtechach, deha ketiv vayyasar et ofan markevotav, kamma retichin havo, dahavo natlin al chad samich galgalla, deitpakdu alayyhu, kevan deitavar hay mishshuletanuta dileh, kullehu retichin itavaru mishshuletanihon, vela natlu. keden kullehu letatta itavaru meshshuletanuta, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 46:25) al mitzrayim veal paro veal habbotchim
595: Uvehahu zimna, shultanuta demitzrayim shalit al kol shear ammin, kevan deitbar chela demitzrayim, ittevar chela dishar ammin. menalan, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:15) az nivhalu allufe edom vegomer. uchetiv (Shemot 15:14) shamu ammim yirgazun vegomer. begin dechullehu havo achidan befulechana demitzrayim, vaachidan bemitzrayim lesiyyua dilhon. uvehahu zimna, kullehu baan lesiyyua demitzrayim, leittatkefa. veal da, kevan deshamu gevuran deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, rafu yedehon, vela yachilu lemekam, veizdaazau kullehu, veittebaru (mashevaleshaleyhevan) mishshuletanathon.

Vadday kad ittevar chela dilhon leella, ittevar chela dechol innun daachidan beh, kevan deitbar chela dechullehu leella, kol hane diltatta ittebaru, begin (hahu) hay chela deitbar bekadmita. uvegin kach vayyasar et ofan markevotav ketiv. vaynahagehu bichvedut, deha kad da ittevar, la havo azlin.
Ta chaze dehachi hu, dela ketiv vayyasar et ofanni markevotav, o ofan merkavto, ella vayyasar et ofan markevotav. begin hay chela, dechullehu havo mitdabbekan beh. (hachi ikrun)

Vetu, vayyasar et ofan markevotav, ta chaze, (vayyasar et ofen markevotav) zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itrae behu, leitdabbeka behu, ulemeheve lehu chulak, ulemehve innun chulakeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 13) uvo tidbakun. uchetiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem, baAdonai mammash. uchetiv (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah. uchetiv (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato. deappik lon mizzara kaddisha, lemeheve chulakeh, veal da yahav lon orayyta kaddisha illaa, geniza tere alfin shenin, ad la yitbere alma, veha ittemar. uvegin rechimuta dileh yahava leyisrael, lemehach avatrah, uleitdabbeka bah.

Ta chaze, kol mashiryayn dilella, vechol innun retichin, kullehu achidan illen beillen, dargin bedargin, illen illain, veillen tattain, veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) ze hayyam gadol. vechevata kaddisha aleh, vechullehu uchelosin umashshiryayn, kullehu natlin techot yedah, al memrah natlin, veal memrah sharan. beidana dehi natla, kullehu netilin, begin dechullehu achidan bah. (amar Rabbi yitzchak)

Veta chaze, beshaata devae kudesha berich hu, leabera leuchelosin defaro letatta, abar bekadmita lehahu chela dilhon, kema deokimna. ma aved. abar vesalik hahu atar kaddisha illaa, dehava madbar (90 manhig) lechol innun retichin, kevan dehay istelik, hanehu kullehu mashshiryayn la yachilu ledabbera, kevan deinnun la yachilu, hahu memana demitzrae aberu leh mishshuletaneh, veabar (10 amud bet) benura dedalik, ucheden shultanuta demitzrae itade. veal da, anusa mippeni yisrael. may tama, begin dechamu memana demitzrayim ittokad benura.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, beshaata dekarivu yisrael leyamma, kara kudesha berich hu lammana ravreva deal yamma, amar leh, beshaata daavadit ana alma, maniti lach al yamma, utenay it li al yamma, di yivza memoy mikkame banay. hasheta mata idana, deyaavrun banay bego yamma. levatar ma ketiv, vayyashav hayyam lifnot boker leetano. may leetano, litnao dehava leh bekudesha berich hu kad bara alma.

Vahavu yisrael sharan al yamma, vahavu yisrael chaman, galgalle yamma sallekin venachtin, zakfu enayyhu, vechamu lefaro uleuchelosin dileh, dechilu vetzaaku. veha ittemar. hayyam raa, ma chama yamma. arona deyosef ka chama, vearak mikkameh. may tama, (begin) dichtiv, (Bereshit 39:12) vayyanas vayyetze hachutza. veal da hayyam raa vayyanos, uchetiv vayyasar et ofan markevotav vegomer anusa mippene yisrael. may taama. begin dechamu ara demitzrayim, keillu ittokad benura, keden amru anusa mippeni yisrael.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, havo azle bemadbera, amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, ta veema lach, dechad kudesha berich hu bae leabera shuletanuta deara, la avid, ad deabar shultanuta dilhon birkia, vela abar shultana dilhon, ad demane achara beatreh, begin dela yigra (shuletanuta) shimmusha dilhon
596: Birkia, begin lekayyeyma ma dichtiv, (daneyalad) uleman di yitzbe yitteninna. amar ribbi yose, vday hachi hu.

Patach Rabbi yose veamar, (Tehillim 8:2) Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz. Adonai adoninu: kad bae kudesha berich hu letavra chela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, atkif dineh alayyhu, vetavar lon, veabar mikkameh shuletanuta dilhon.

Asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim, asher natatta mibbae leh, o tena hodcha, mahu asher tena hodcha. ella da hu raza denahara amika decholla, vedavid baa bauteh, lemingad minneh al hashshamayim, veda hu (Vayikra 65 amud bet) asher. kema deat amer, (Shemot 3:14) ehye asher ehye.

Beshaata dehay nahara (63 amud bet, Bereshit 221 amud alef) amikta decholla, nagid venafik al hashshamayim, kedin kolla bechidu, umatronita itatterat bemalka, vechol almin kullehu bechidu, veshultanuta deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, itavar mikkame matronita, ucheden zakfin resha kol man daachidu bah.

Addehachi chamu chad bar nash, dehava ate, vechad matula kameh. amar ribbi chiyyay, nezil, dilma hay bar nash oved avodat kochavim umazzalot hu, o am haaretz hu, veasir leishtattefa bahadeh bearcha. amar ribbi yose, netiv hacha, venechome, dilma gavra rabba hu.

Addehachi, abar kamayyhu, amar leh, bedukefa dimabara dekotifa dehay, chavruta ivae, vaana yedana archa achara, veniste mehay, vaana baina deema lechu, vela itchayyayvna bechu, vela abar al ma dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:14) velifni ivver lo titten michshol, veattun kesumin bearcha da, vela tistakkenu benafshayychu. amar ribbi yose, berich rachamana deorichna hacha, itchabberu bahadeh. amar lon, la tishtau midi hacha, ad denaavor behay. satu bearcha achara.

Batar denafku mehahu atar, amar lon, behahu archa achara, havo azle zimna chada, chad kohen chacham, vechad kohen am haaretz bahadeh, kam hahu am haaretz behahu atar aleh vekatleh. mehahu yoma kol man deabar behahu atar, mistakken benafsheh. veha mitchabberin taman meshaddede turaya, vekatlin vekappechin livne nasha, veinnun deyade la avre tamman, uvae kudesha berich hu dama dehahu kahana kol yoma.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 10:32) od hayyom benov laamod vegomer ha ukemuha innun mare metivta. aval ana la amena lechu hachi, ella deraza demilla olifna. od hayyom, man yoma den. ella, hachi ketiv, (Shemot 6:23) vayyikkach aharon et elisheva bat amminadav. veraza hu, al keneset yisrael, deaharon hu shoshvina dilah, letakkena beta uleshammesha lah, ulemeal lah lemalka leizdavvevga kachada, mikkan ulehala, kol kohen dimshammesh bemakdesha, kegavvna deaharon.

Achimelecha kahana rabba illaa hava, vechol innun kahani bahadeh, kullehu havo shushevinin dematronita, kevan deitkatilu, ishtaarat matronita bilchodaha, veitavid shoshvina dilah, vela ishtechach man dimshammesh kamah, vitakken beta, vichadde lah leizdavvevga im malka. keden mehahu yoma, itabbera lismala, vekayyeyma al alma, kamin al kolla, katil leshaul velivnoy, itavid minayyhu malchu, mitu miyyisrael kamma alfin vechamma rivvavn. vead kean, hahu chova hava tale, ad deata sancheriv veargiz kolla.

Veda hu od hayyom benov, da hu yoma illaa, uman ihu. da keneset yisrael, deavdat shushevinin dilah, hahi deishtearat belo yemina, (dahave leh) leitdabbeka bismala. dechahana yemina hu. (amar leh leitdabbeka bismala) uvegin kach, od hayyom benov laamod.

Ta chaze, ketiv givat shaul nasa, shaul amay hacha. ella begin dehu katil lechahane, vegarim deroa yemina, leitakra mealma. uf hacha, mehahu yoma, la abar bar nash behahu ducheta, begin dela istakken benafsheh. amar leh ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, vela amarit lach dilma gavra rabba hu.
Patach veamar, (Mishlei 3:13) ashre adam matza chachma. ashre adam,
597: Kegon anan, deashkachna lach, veyadana minach milla dechachmeta. veadam yafik tevuna, kegon anan, deorichna lach leitchabbera bahadach. veda hu bar nash dezammin leh kudesha berich hu nevizbeza bearcha, anpoy dishchinta, veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga. azlu.

Patach hahu gavra veamar (Tehillim 24:1) ledavid mizmor laAdonai haaretz umeloah vegomer. ledavid mizmor baatar chad, uvaatar achara mizmor ledavid, ma ben hay (170 amud alef) lehay. ella ledavid mizmor, shirata dekaamar david, al keneset yisrael. mizmor ledavid, shirata dekaamar david, al garmeh.

LaAdonai (22 amud bet) haaretz umeloah. laAdonai: da kudesha berich hu. haaretz umeloah: da keneset yisrael, vechol uchelosin dilah, demitchabberan bahadah, veikrun meloah vadday hu. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 6:3) melo chol haaretz kevodo tevel veyoshve vah: da hu ara diltatta, deikre tevel, vaachidat bedina (dealma) dilella, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 9:9) vehu yishfot tevel betzedek, ben lechad, ben leamma chad, ben lechol alma, mehay dina hu ittedan.

Ta chaze, paro mehay dina yanik, ad deitavidu hu vechol ammeh. kevan dehay dina ittear aleh, hahu memana deitmana alayyhu beshultanuta, itade veitavar, keden kullehu diltatta, itavidu, dichtiv vayyasar et ofan markevotav. may ofan markevotav. markevotav defaro. uman ihu hahu ofan dilhon, hahu memana deshalit alayyhu. veal da mitu kullehu beyamma. amay beyamma, ella yamma illaa ittear alayyhu, veitmechu (nusach acher veitmesaru) bidaha. uvegin kach tubbeu bayyam sof ketiv. amar ribbi yose vadday hachi hu, veal da ketiv, tubbeu beyam suf. sofa dedargin.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, vaynahagehu bichvedut. bichvedut mahu. ella mikkan olifna, divhahu dabberuta deitdabbar beh bar nash, medabberin leh. befaro ketiv (Shemot 9:7) vayyichbad lev paro. behahu milla, davar leh kudesha berich hu, bichvedut mammash. amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, at okir libbach. ana adbar lach behay, al da vaynahagehu bichvedut.

Vayyomer mitzrayim anusa mippene yisrael vegomer. vayyomer mitzrayim, da memana deitmene al mitzrae. amar ribbi yose, hay milla kashya, kevan deaberu leh mishshuletanute, hech yachil hu lemirdaf avatrayyhu deyisrael.

Ella vadday hachi hu. aval da vayyomer mitzrayim, mitzrayim diltatta. ki Adonai nilcham lahem vemitzrayim, mitzrayim dilella, dechevan deitbar chelehon milleella, keden ittevar chela vetukepa dilhon letatta, hada hu dichtiv ki Adonai nilcham lahem vemitzrayim. bemitzrayim dayka. da hu tukepa dilhon dilella. veda hu deukemuha melech mitzrayim setam. hacha, vayyomer mitzrayim anusa mippene yisrael, dechamu deha ittevar chelehon, vetukepa dilhon, dilella.

Ta chaze, kad ittearat hay keneset yisrael, itaru kol inun daachidan bah, vechullehu acharanin diltatta, veyisrael leella mikkullehu, deha inun natle la begufa deilana, veha ukemuha. uvegine kach yisrael achidan bah, yattir mikkol ovde kochavim umazzalot. vechad inun mitarin, (kol ammim 136) itbar tukefhon meinnun deshalte alayyhu.

Ta chazi, hay memana shultana demitzrae, dachik lon leyisrael, bechamma shibudin, kema deukemuha. levatar deitbar hu bekadmita, ittebaru innun malkevavta (sefer acher milletatta), hada hu dichtiv ki Adonai nilcham lahem bemitzrayim. nilcham lahem vday.

Sefer acher tosefta (Shemot 14:19) vyyissa malach haelohim vegomer. (matnitin) ad la (sefer acher ishteka) ishtechach avira dachya, vela nehirin, avanin nekivan havo setiman. telat ruchin dichlilan bitlat, havo shekian. umayin setiman techot nukeve. beshivin uteren atvavn ithaddaru leatrayyhu
598: Batar shivin uteren dargin, vechen telat zimnin, itbakau vitnekivu avane, techot tzerora dehava chakik, veitkenafu dargin, veitavidu kenufeya chada. (sefer acher itpelag veitavidu kenufeya chad)
Levatar itpelagu, veitavidu teren dargin, palguta mayya aglidu, ufalguta ishtekau. illen seliku, veillen nachtu, mehacha shara alma leitpalga.

Tzerora achara (nusach acher chada) it leella, (leella) vehu gelifa 74 chatiman degushepanka takkifa, uvehu shekian galgalloy deyamma. kad natlin, itpelagu learba zavveyayn. palgu chada salik, ufalgu chada nachit, palgu chada listar tzafon, ufalgu chada listar darom. kad mitchabberan kachada, gumerin delahatin kayymin, belahat shinnana decharba demithappecha.

Chad kayyeyma naitz bego yamma, darga shelicha deafarcha illaa, salik behahu kayayma leella leella, ishtechlal (nusach acher istakkal) lemerachik, ketura dearbin deshatin beyamma. man chame galgallin desallekin venachtin verucha denashiv behu, venune yamma nagdin kol innun arbin lechol sitre alma.

Hahu darga, kad nachit mehahu, kayyme elef mimineh, veelef missemaleh, hava tav veyativ beatreh, kemalka bechuresye, hahu darga dechad shate yamma learba sitre alma, immeh nafkat, beh tevat, hu tav bekiyyuma demalka.

Keden charozin nafkin, man mare deayynin, yizdakfan lon leella leella. marehon degadpin yekumun bekiyyumayyhu. mare deanpin, chafyayn lon, ad denatil bematlanoy. keden vayyissa malach haelohim. (74 kan).

Ribbi chiyyay patach, (Mishlei 31:14) hayta kooniyyot socher mimmerchak tavi lachmah. hayta kooniyyot socher, da cheneset yisrael. mimmerchak tavi lachmah, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 30:27) hinne shem Adonai ba mimmerchak. tavi lachmah, bechad darga deshari alah, uveh itmeshachu kol illen nechalin umabbuin deazlin beyamma, kema deat amer, (Kohelet 1:7) kol (Vayikra 58 amud alef) hannechalim holchim el hayyam vegomer.

El makom shehannechalim holchim, af al gav dechullehu nechalin itmashshechan behahu darga, vehahu darga nachit (nusach acher nagid) lon lehahu yamma, la tema. deha arik lon, veha la sharyayn beh acharanin, vela nagdin beh kemilkaddemin, ahdar veamar el makom shehannechalim holchim sham hem shavim, el makom dehahu darga denachalin azlin zimna chada, sham hem shavim lalachet, tamman innun tayyvin mehahu atar illaa, vela paskin lealmin, umitkanneshe kullehu behahu atar. velamma. lalachet. lemehach lehahu atar deyamma, kema deittemar, ma shemeh dehahu darga. tzaddik ikre.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ketiv (Tehillim 104:26) sham oniyyot yehallechun livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo. sham oniyyot yehallechun, behahu yamma deazlin veshatin, ad deatyayn leitchabbera behahu darga, keden ketiv livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, leella leella yattir, it ziuuga achara, deshari bachavivuta, vela (Vayikra sefer acher amud bet, 77 amud bet, 55 amud alef, 26 amud alef) mitperash lealmin. amar ribbi yehuda, man zache lehahu ziuuga. amar leh, man deit leh chulaka bealma deate. bealma deate dayka.

Amar leh, veha mehacha olifna, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:26) livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo, mashma dekaamar ze, veze vezot yedian innun. amar ribbi abba, tarvavyychu shappir kaamrittu, veha deribbi yehuda shappir dayka, vecholla zammin kudesha berich hu leitanga behu letzaddikayyay, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai.

Amar ribbi abba, kamma alfin, kamma ribbevan demashshiryayn kaddishin, it leh lekudesha berich hu, mare deanpin illain, mare deayynin, mare dezayynin, mare dilala, mare divava, mare derachame, mare dedina, veella minnayyhu afkad lematronita leshamsha behechla kameh.

Lokovel illen, it lah lematronita, mashiryan mezyyaynin. beshittin (beshatta) anpin mishtachchu mashreyayn mezuyaynin. vechullehu chagiran charba, kayyeyman besacharanaha, kama nafkin, kama ayylin. beshit gadpin tasin kol alma. kame kol chad vechad gumarin denur dalik. levushoy, mitlahata eshsha. begabboy, shinnana decharba mitlahata bechol alma, lenatra
599: Kamah. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:24) veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et derech etz hachayyim.

Man derech etz hachayyim. da hi matronita rabbeta, dehi archa, lehahu ilana ravreva takkif, ilana dechayye. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael. yisrael dilella, kullam achuze cherev.

Kad natla matronita, kullehu natlin bahadah, hada hu dichtiv vayyissa malach haelohim. vechi malach haelohim itkere. amar ribbi abba in. ta chaze, hachi amar ribbi shimon, atkin kudesha berich hu kameh, hechala kaddisha, hechala illaa, (kaddisha) karta kaddisha, karta illaa. yerushelem ir hakkodesh ikre, man deal lemalka, la al ella mehahu karta kaddisha, natil archa lemalka, dearcha mehacha ittatkan.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:20) ze hashshaar laAdonai tzaddikim yavou vo. kol shelichuta devae malka mibbe matronita nafka, vechol shelichuta mittatta lemalka, (nusach acher devae malka) leve matronita ayiyil bekadmita, umittamman lemalka. ishtechach dematronita ihi shelicha decholla, meella letatta, umittatta leella. veal da, ihi shelicha decholla, hada hu dichtiv vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifne machane yisrael, yisrael dilella. malach haelohim, hada hu dichtiv beh, vaAdonai holech lifnehem vegomer, vehay lalechet yomam velayla, kema deukemuha.

Vechi yekara hu demalka, dematronita tezzil, vehi tiggach kerava, vehi azlat shelicha. ella, lemalka deizdavvavg bematronita illaa, chama malka yekiru dilah, al kol shear matronita dealma, amar kullehu mishtakkechin lechenata (nusach acher lachevapetaa), lokovel hay matronita dili. hi salleka al kolla, ma avid lah. ella kol beta dili yehe bidaha, appik malka karoza, mehacha kol millin demalka bida dematronita yitmasserun. ma avid. afkid malka bidaha kol zayynin dileh, kol innun mare maggichin kerava, kol innun avanin yekirin demalka, kol ginzayyay demalka. amar, mehacha, kol man deyitzterich lemallela immi, la yachil lemallela immi, ad deoda lah matronita.

Kacha kudesha berich hu, missegiut chavivuta urechimuta dileh bekneset yisrael, afkid kolla birshutah, amar, ha kol shaari, la mishtakkeche kelum legabbaha. amar, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) shishshim hemma melachot vegomer, achat hi yonati tammati. ma avid lah, ella, ha kol beta dili bidaha. appik malka karoza, mehacha kol millin demalka, bida dematronita yitmasserun. afkid bidaha kol zayynin dileh, romchin, vesayyfin, kashtin, chitztzin, vacharavin, balisterin. kastirain, ain, avanin, kol innun mare (nusach acher mane) maggiche kerava. hada hu dichtiv, hinni mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim vegomer kullam achuziyi cherev melummede vegomer.

Amar malka, mikkan ulehala, kerava dili itmesar bidach, zayynin dili, mare maggiche kerava bidach. mikkan ulehala at have natra li, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 121) shomer yisrael. mikkan ulehala, man deitzterich li, la yachil lemallela immi, ad deoda lematronita, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. shelicha demalka becholla, kema deokimna. ishtechach decholla bidaha, veda hu yekara dematronita. hada hu dichtiv, vayyissa malach haelohim vegomer, kema deittemar.

Vayyelecha meacharehem, may tama meacharehem. begin deyishtechachu lekamaha (nusach acher lagebahea) mare maggiche kerava, mare ballisteraot, mare romchin vesayyfin, veitgelun kamaha, deha havo atyayn mashiryayn acharanin, leaggacha kerava beyisrael milleella, veal da vayyelech meacharehem.

Vetana, behahi shaata, ata ravreva shultana dimmana al mitzrae, vechanash shit mea (rabevaven) retichin mekatregin, veal kol reticha ureticha, shit mea shaltanin memanan kategorin, hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach shesh meot rechev bachur vegomer. vechi shesh meot rechev bachur, la havo richve mitzrayim, may tama vechol rechev mitzrayim. ella hachi tana, hava samael ozif leh, shit mea retichin mekatregin lesayyeya leh. hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach shesh meot rechev
